|

Good evening everyone,

President Biden has decided not to seek re-election and has endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris as his choice to lead our great nation when his term ends.

My opponent has wasted no time in stating his position that no matter who is running as the Democratic nominee, he will continue to grow the Republican majority and secure four more years of Donald Trump as president. Rick Allen is a Trump loyalist and has always made that very clear.

**I say, not so fast.**

We know what that means. This race is so much more than a decision about which political party leads our nation. This election is different and there is no time to sit on the sidelines.

Four more years of Rick Allen and Donald Trump means continued attacks on women’s rights and a continued decline in their health and life expectancy. It means more money for those, like them, at the very top and even less for the majority who are already struggling.

We are not going to let that happen. Say it out loud with me friends.

**We are not going to let that happen!**

We are fed up but we have been fed up before and we don’t give up. Now is the time to straighten our backs, know what we are facing and continue to push forward to victory.

I believe that while the past month has been unexpected and challenging, great things are on the horizon. History making things that will move us all forward toward peace and prosperity.

Are you with me? Together we can do this!

As always, I thank you for your support,
Liz

I want to take a moment to thank President Biden for all he has done for the American people.
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89306213/486863501/1790176412?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzgyNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZjExZDMwMi1jMDQ3LWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Bh5C38lkFqYUmZ7LMAn9bZJUqJF_ZXVUNy1V_caCzMI=&emci=9b2f42e9-b447-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=6f11d302-c047-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=23311593) | Peter,

This afternoon, President Biden announced he would step aside as the Democratic nominee and no longer seek re-election.

**I want to express my heartfelt thanks to President Biden for stepping up and serving the nation.**

We may not have seen eye-to-eye on every issue, but I was proud to work with him to lower prescription drug costs and cap the price of insulin, bring millions of dollars to northeastern Pennsylvania for critical infrastructure upgrades, and invest in clean, renewable energy to combat climate change and create good-paying, American jobs. **Together, we made amazing progress for Pennsylvanians – and Americans nationwide.**

The president deserves support as he completes his term in office, as he swore an oath to do.

[**For us here in PA-08, though, our goal of holding this congressional seat is now more important than ever. | | Congressman Russell Fry, South Carolina’s Seventh Congressional District Congressman, is honored and humbled to represent the Pee Dee and Grand Strand areas in Washington, D.C. Russell Fry is the successful product of the American Dream. He learned from his parents that there is no such thing as a free lunch and that success comes from hard work and determination. Russell self-funded his undergraduate education at the University of South Carolina and then earned his law degree at the Charleston School of Law. In law school, he served as Student Bar Association president, helped the school achieve its American Bar Association accreditation, and received the prestigious Civility Award. For over a decade, he practiced law all along the Grand Strand. Russell has always been a public servant and an advocate for the conservative movement. Prior to his election to U.S. Congress, Russell Fry represented Horry County in the South Carolina General Assembly. As Chief Majority Whip in the State House, he fought to lower taxes, defend the unborn, and safeguard the 2nd Amendment. Additionally, Russell fought to put 18 policy initiatives into law in his time as Chairman of the SC House Opioid Abuse Prevention Study Committee. This legislation provided funding for education on opioids, opioid prevention, and opioid treatment. Russell and his wife, Bronwen, have one son, James. name: Sarah McBride
subject: Joe Biden and Kamala Harris
body:
Vice President Harris is the leader for this moment, poised to build on our progress, challenge Donald Trump, and energize our party.
#
President Biden is the definition of a true patriot, and he has led the most accomplished administration we’ve seen in my lifetime.
The Biden-Harris Administration has achieved historic employment, addressed climate change, and bolstered economic opportunity. Throughout his career as Senator, Vice President, and President, Joe Biden has championed working families with decency and selflessness. Today’s announcement was one more act of selfless patriotism and one more display of his deep love of this country. I’m proud of my friend and my fellow Delawarean.
It’s easy to be cynical but President Biden has never done that — now more than ever, we need to channel his hope and determination to continue the work of saving our democracy.
When I — and millions of Americans — voted for Biden in 2020 and supported his renomination, we did so knowing that Kamala Harris was his capable running mate, prepared to lead if necessary. As Vice President, she has advanced historic change and is ready to continue the Biden-Harris Administration’s progress.
**Vice President Harris is the leader for this moment, poised to build on our progress, challenge Donald Trump, and energize our party.** With her as our nominee, Democrats will be united to win in November and protect critical rights and services.
I’m proud to support Kamala Harris for President and am ready to work hard to call her “Madam President” in January 2025.

clean_body: Vice President Harris is the leader for this moment, poised to build on our progress, challenge Donald Trump, and energize our party. President Biden is the definition of a true patriot, and he has led the most accomplished administration we’ve seen in my lifetime. The Biden-Harris Administration has achieved historic employment, addressed climate change, and bolstered economic opportunity. Throughout his career as Senator, Vice President, and President, Joe Biden has championed working families with decency and selflessness. Today’s announcement was one more act of selfless patriotism and one more display of his deep love of this country. I’m proud of my friend and my fellow Delawarean. It’s easy to be cynical but President Biden has never done that — now more than ever, we need to channel his hope and determination to continue the work of saving our democracy. When I — and millions of Americans — voted for Biden in 2020 and supported his renomination, we did so knowing that Kamala Harris was his capable running mate, prepared to lead if necessary. As Vice President, she has advanced historic change and is ready to continue the Biden-Harris Administration’s progress. Vice President Harris is the leader for this moment, poised to build on our progress, challenge Donald Trump, and energize our party. With her as our nominee, Democrats will be united to win in November and protect critical rights and services. I’m proud to support Kamala Harris for President and am ready to work hard to call her “Madam President” in January 2025. I was with the Vice President yesterday and saw the enthusiasm she fosters among my fellow Democrats. With her as our nominee, Democrats will be united and energized to win up and down the ballot in November to protect abortion rights, pass paid leave, secure affordable child care, health care, and housing, and ban assault weapons nationwide. Thank you, Sarah McBride

| | Caroleene Dobson is a distinguished attorney, wife, mother, District Two resident, and a lifelong advocate for conservative values. Born and raised in Beatrice, Alabama, Dobson grew up on her family's fifth-generation cattle farm, where she learned the meaning of hard work and developed a firsthand understanding of the challenges faced by hardworking families and entrepreneurs. Currently practicing real estate law at the Maynard Nexsen law firm, Dobson represents a diverse clientele, including homebuilders, retailers, small business owners, and private landowners. She has spent her career advocating for her client’s interests while also achieving tangible, positive outcomes. In Congress, she will hold true to her core conservative values while ensuring Washington D.C. is working for the people of District Two. A passionate advocate for families, farms, and faith, Dobson aims to preserve the bedrock values and moral backbone that have defined our nation. With a call for Alabama common sense, she is determined to challenge the far-left agenda in Washington, D.C., advocating for the rights of property owners and defending the freedom to think, speak, and act without interference. Caroleene, alongside her husband Bobby, is the proud parent of two daughters, Philippa and Lydia. Her decision to run for Congress is deeply rooted in a desire to secure a future for her children and to champion the principles that have made America the land of the free.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=biden_drops_out_response&n=1)

* * *
---
Peter,

For well over a year, the overwhelming majority of Americans have said they did not want Joe Biden to be the Democratic nominee for president.

As of today, he won’t be.

We could all see the writing on the wall, but today’s developments are nonetheless shocking.

The entire Democratic party infrastructure organized to conceal the truth about the president’s capacity to serve another four years. They aggressively rigged the primary to ensure he had no credible challengers – just as they fixed the game in 2020 and in 2016.

Now the Democrats are descending into ever greater dysfunction. Despite the president’s immediate endorsement of his running mate, Vice President Harris, to take his place on the ticket, multiple Democratic leaders are pulling levers and calling in favors to produce a contested convention in just a few weeks’ time.

This is an unprecedented political moment to reset and fundamentally re-order our entire political system.

**[We are calling on voters everywhere to rally behind the only pro-worker, anti-genocide, climate emergency campaign on the ballot for the majority of voters this November. This is our chance to truly challenge empire, end genocide, shut down Trump, and halt the rise of American fascism presided over by both corporate parties.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=biden_drops_out_response&n=2)**

Speaking to this transformational moment and the yearning for deep change, **I am proud to share that we have just received the endorsement of Workers Strike Back** – the working class movement founded by the revolutionary Kshama Sawant – with a resounding 99% vote of support at their inaugural convention today.

Through their arrogance and their lust for power, Democratic leaders ignored the will of voters again and again. Because of their dysfunction and failure to lead, voters are now being told to choose between a ticket led by a racist demagogue – and a ticket with no candidate at all.

Increasingly, voters are choosing a different path – one centered on people, planet, and peace. We welcome all who join our movement today.

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill

$1,400 can pay to send 98,648 digital ads to 55,000 people in the district.

We need to come together as the GIFFORDS community and show Vice President Harris that we have her back
#

Hi friends, it's Gabby Giffords.
I am proud to stand with my friend Vice President Kamala Harris and endorse her historic bid to be our nation’s next president. As her campaign is just starting to ramp up, we need to come together as the GIFFORDS community and show Vice President Harris that we have her back and will work tirelessly to elect her this November.
**If you’re ready to help Kamala Harris become the next president of the United States, please split a $10 contribution between the Harris for President campaign and GIFFORDS PAC today. You can use this special link below:**
[**https://go.giffords.org/go/Harris-Giffords**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-july24-harris.Q8uV0K&refcode=em240721-3-30&t=1&akid=8545%2E3935704%2E0wcAio)
Throughout her life, Vice President Harris has worked to protect the American people and their freedoms. In particular, Kamala Harris has shown that she supports our freedom to live without the fear of gun violence.
During her time as vice president, Kamala Harris has aided President Joe Biden in every one of his historic and lifesaving actions to make our country safer from gun violence.
In 2022, she worked alongside President Biden to help pass the _Bipartisan Safer Communities Act_ —the most significant gun safety legislation in nearly 30 years. Then in 2023, she worked with President Biden to establish the first-ever federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention, which she now oversees.
**I know Vice President Harris, and I know that she is ready to serve the American people as the next president of the United States. As president, she will undoubtedly be a steadfast partner in our movement for gun safety, just like she has been for the past four years.**
[**So please, if you’re all-in to elect Kamala Harris this November, I’m asking you to split a contribution between the Harris campaign and GIFFORDS PAC today.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-july24-harris.Q8uV0K&refcode=em240721-3-30&t=2&akid=8545%2E3935704%2E0wcAio)

body:

My fellow Americans, Over the past three and a half years, we have made great progress as a nation. Today, America has the strongest economy in the world. We've made historic investments in rebuilding our nation, in lowering prescription drug costs for seniors, and in expanding affordable health care to a record number of Americans. We've provided critically needed care to a million veterans exposed to toxic substances. Passed the first gun safety law in 30 years. Appointed the first African American woman to the Supreme Court. And passed the most significant climate legislation in the history of the world. America has never been better positioned to lead than we are today. I know none of this could have been done without you, the American people. Together, we overcame a once in a century pandemic and the worst economic crisis since the Great Depression. We've protected and preserved our democracy. And we've revitalized and strengthened our alliances around the world. It has been the greatest honor of my life to serve as your President. And while it has been my intention to seek reelection, I believe it is in the best interest of my party and the country for me to stand down and to focus solely on fulfilling my duties as President for the remainder of my term. For my part: my very first decision as the party nominee in 2020 was to pick Kamala Harris as my Vice President. And it’s been the best decision I’ve made. **Today I want to offer my full support and endorsement for Kamala to be the nominee of our party this year. clean_body: | | | My fellow Americans, Over the past three and a half years, we have made great progress as a nation. Today, America has the strongest economy in the world. We've made historic investments in rebuilding our nation, in lowering prescription drug costs for seniors, and in expanding affordable health care to a record number of Americans. We've provided critically needed care to a million veterans exposed to toxic substances. Passed the first gun safety law in 30 years. Appointed the first African American woman to the Supreme Court. And passed the most significant climate legislation in the history of the world. America has never been better positioned to lead than we are today. I know none of this could have been done without you, the American people. Together, we overcame a once in a century pandemic and the worst economic crisis since the Great Depression. We've protected and preserved our democracy. And we've revitalized and strengthened our alliances around the world. It has been the greatest honor of my life to serve as your President. And while it has been my intention to seek reelection, I believe it is in the best interest of my party and the country for me to stand down and to focus solely on fulfilling my duties as President for the remainder of my term. For my part: my very first decision as the party nominee in 2020 was to pick Kamala Harris as my Vice President. And it’s been the best decision I’ve made. Today I want to offer my full support and endorsement for Kamala to be the nominee of our party this year. Hi friend,
Nearly four years ago, President Biden put an end to Donald Trump’s chaos. He put us on a path toward progress, began to turn the page on Ronald Reagan’s failed trickle-down economics, and put working American families at the center of his agenda.
I am deeply grateful for President Biden’s decades of public service and commitment to our nation. As president, he expanded the Child Tax Credit to cut childhood poverty nearly in half. He passed a major infrastructure bill and common-sense gun reform, overcame Big Pharma to cut drug prices, and signed into law a historic climate bill. He united our allies to stand up for Ukraine and global democracy. President Biden has made our country stronger and safer.
Today, President Biden passed the torch to Vice President Kamala Harris and gave us the best chance to beat Donald Trump in November.
It is my honor to endorse Vice President Harris to be our Democratic presidential nominee and the next President of the United States.
From our time together on the Senate Intelligence Committee to our shared commitment to expanding the Child Tax Credit, I have seen firsthand Vice President Harris’ dedication to our country’s security and our children’s prosperity. She is the candidate we need to beat Donald Trump.
As our nominee, she will inspire and lead the American people with an economic vision that brings us together, instead of dividing us. She will forcefully defend a woman’s right to control her own body. She will speak to the future our children and their children righteously demand.
She has the experience, record, and integrity to be the next President of the United States. Now, we need to make sure she has the resources.

body:
I fully support Kamala Harris as our Democratic presidential nominee. |
---
_Democrat Eric Swalwell represents California's 14th Congressional District. _
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89307833/486895920/-1590518309?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS85MDcyNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYzRhNDQyYi1kOTQ3LWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2CIc1G3-rMRLsCYMAvt7OMo7MF3wtlcc_76eNfSnvH4=&emci=2fe5da17-d447-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=1c4a442b-d947-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=7878003)
I’m sure you’ve seen the news. **Earlier today, President Joe Biden stepped down as the Democratic nominee for President.** I want to thank President Biden for his over 60 years of service to our great nation and for the legacy of selfless leadership he cements with his decision today — _a stark contrast to the legacy of chaos and disorder Donald Trump continues to inflict on our nation._ In 2020, President Biden saved our nation from a ruin from which we may never have recovered: another term under Trump. **His decision today will ensure Democrats can once again safeguard our democracy and shows the difference between a selfless leader and Donald Trump, a selfish person. ** Vice President Harris is tough, whip-smart, and ready to lead us into victory in November. She’s trained with the best — Joe Biden. I stand with her all the way and am ready to do whatever it takes to win. The stakes in this election are just too great. It has been the honor of a lifetime to serve alongside our Commander-in-Chief, my friend, President Joe Biden — one of the finest public servants we will ever know. And I am honored to have his support and endorsement.
| | | I am running to be President of the United States.

**It has been the honor of a lifetime to serve alongside our Commander-in-Chief, my friend, President Joe Biden — one of the finest public servants we will ever know. And I am honored to have his support and endorsement.**

And I am eager to run on the record of what Joe and I have accomplished together. We built our country back after our predecessor left it in shambles -- making historic progress in reducing prescription drug costs, upgrading our nation's infrastructure, fighting climate change, and more. We are stronger today because we took action -- together -- to invest in America's future.

I am excited to continue to work toward our vision for a better future for all. But we also need to expand Democrats' majority in the Senate to continue to deliver progress for the American people. body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**July 21, 2024** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST** **By Heidi Ganahl**
| | Hi Folks,
What a whirlwind week in politics! We've witnessed an assassination attempt, an incredible unifying RNC, and President Biden suspending his re-election. These events highlight the urgent need for unity and strong leadership.
The RNC brought together voices like Hulk Hogan, Eric Trump, Charlie Kirk, and Tim Scott, who reignited our passion for American values. The convention was a beacon of hope, reminding us of the importance of coming together during these challenging times. With Biden's unexpected departure, our nation faces a critical moment. Now more than ever, we must unite as a strong Rocky Mountain state. It is essential to stay informed and engaged, ensuring that we navigate these turbulent times with resilience and resolve.
Thank you for your support and dedication. Together, we can work towards a stable and prosperous future
With gratitude,
Heidi
---
|
---
| | **STATE**
---
**[Griswold calls for recount in House District 58 Republican primary race decided by three votes](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Three votes. That’s how close the Colorado House District 58 Republican primary race was between Larry Don Suckla and Mark Roeber.
**[More than 100 poultry workers likely exposed to avian flu, Colorado health officials say](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) State health workers distributed antiviral medication earlier this week to more than 150 workers who were potentially exposed to poultry infected with avian flu at a commercial egg facility in Weld County.

**[Colorado GOP sues county Republican officers to block effort to remove Dave Williams as party chair](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The Colorado Republican Party sued two county GOP officers late Thursday in an attempt to block a group of Republicans from removing Dave Williams as the state party’s chairman.
_**[READ MORE STATE NEWS]()**_
|
---
**NATIONAL**
**[Biden ends bid for second term in White House as he drops out of his 2024 rematch with Trump](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) President Joe Biden announced Sunday that he will suspend his 2024 re-election campaign amid mounting pressure from his Democratic colleagues on Capitol Hill, top donors and Hollywood stars after a disastrous debate performance last month.
**[Polis: Biden’s decision to withdraw not easy ‘but it is the right one’](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) In the moments following President Joe Biden’s announcement he would suspend his campaign for re-election, Gov. Jared Polis responded in a manner similar to President John F. Kennedy’s moon challenge speech.

**[Zuckerberg: Donald Trump’s reaction to being shot ‘most badass things I’ve ever seen in my life’](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) ** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Elon Musk is not the only social media mogul digging former President Donald Trump these days.
_**[READ MORE NATIONAL NEWS]()**_

|
---
**LOCAL**
**[For third time since 2019, Jefferson Co. voters will weigh in on elimination of TABOR refunds](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) For the third time in five years, Jefferson County’s elected officials are asking voters to allow the local government to spend all of the revenue that it collects above the Taxpayer’s Bill of Rights limit, thereby eliminating refunds to taxpayers.
**[Douglas Co. has invested $2.7 million in a helicopter, and says it is worth it](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CBS COLORADO ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Douglas County fire crews experienced a busy weekend as a heat wave warmed the Denver metro area. The agency’s fire suppression helicopter responded to several calls, including a destructive brush fire in Byers Arapahoe County, a plane’s emergency landing and three smoke checks.
**[Thanks to illegals, enrollment slump for Denver schools comes to an end](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE CENTER SQUARE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Denver Public Schools saw a boost in enrollment for the first time since the pandemic thanks to a surge of migrant students, according to a report the school board received this week.

**[In advance of election, Boulder City Council to weigh long-term plan for closing municipal airport by 2041](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [BOULDER REPORTING LAB ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) City of Boulder officials are asking councilmembers to decide next week whether the city should begin the process of closing the Boulder Municipal Airport by 2041. According to a city staff memo published this week, 2041 is the date when the city estimates it will no longer be obligated to keep the airport operating under Federal Aviation Administration regulations.

Vance, Trump’s vice-presidential candidate, a Marine veteran and first Millennial on a major-party ticket](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _When former President Donald J. Trump announced U.S. Sen. J.D. Vance, R-Ohio, would be his vice-presidential running mate on the Republican Party’s presidential ticket, it concluded months of speculation._
**[Fabbricatore: A law enforcement leader’s perspective on the assassination attempt on President Trump](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Have you ever experienced a situation where things happen that are done right, but still go horribly wrong? The recent assassination attempt on President Donald Trump’s life is a stark example of this._
**[Hancey: An open letter to Ms. Reed, asking for your resignation](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _I respectfully ask for your immediate resignation!_
**[Gaines: Is Gov. Polis sending homeless people to my hometown? Fact check finds no support to claim](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _I was talking to a friend the other day and he remarked that his neighbor had told him that Gov. Polis was sending homeless people out to Sterling, Colo._

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: Biden drops out
body:
President Joe Biden will NOT seek reelection...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

By now, you’ve seen the news that President Joe Biden will **NOT** seek reelection this fall.

This decision isn’t surprising given the fact he’s been trailing in polls for months, and members of his own party have been actively trying to push him out.

Now the question everyone’s asking is: **_Who will be the new head of the pro-abortion serpent?_**

Yes, President Biden did endorse Vice President Kamala Harris to take his place, but that doesn't mean she's a guarenteed shoo-in.

We'll have to wait until August 19th – 22nd to see who ends up getting the official nomination at the Democratic National Convention.

Regardless of who it ends up being – Kamala, Gavin, Gretchen, etc, – I can guarantee you that the candidate will be just as rabidly pro-abortion as President Biden – _if not even more radical._

Pro-Life Friend, our country has just had one presidential candidate shot and another decide not to seek reelection in a week’s time.

I don’t think we’ve seen the end of all the madness in 2024 either.

We need to keep praying and keep fighting.

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

P.S. – I’ll keep you posted so that, when we know who the Abortion Lobby has finally ordained as their new pro-abortion puppet, you’ll know what our action plan will be!

Stay tuned!

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| |
Dear Fellow American, I hope you’re having a great day. There’s something important I want to share with you today. For years, we’ve seen a growing effort from radical activists to destroy the principles of liberty that have made our nation the freest and most prosperous in history. These radicals have found a willing ally in the Biden administration’s education department. And right now—with the help of these government bureaucrats—they are actively denigrating the U.S. Constitution in America’s schools while teaching destructive ideologies like **critical race theory** and **socialism**. We are at a key point in our history. We **must** defend our nation’s founding documents and principles of liberty through education. And that’s why I’m emailing you today.
---
| | Hillsdale College recently produced a limited number of DVD box sets of our very popular **“Constitution 101”** online course, and I’d like you to have a copy. The course features Hillsdale’s faculty—the same professors who teach our required course on the Constitution on campus. And when you view **“Constitution 101,”** you’ll learn about:
* The original design and purpose of the Constitution.
* The challenges it faced during the Civil War.
* How it has been undermined for over a century by progressivism and liberalism.
* How limited government under the Constitution might be revived in our own time.

| | July 22, 2024
The Democrat mob has finally pried Joe Biden from the presidency. For over a year now I never thought he'd make it to the convention, because his obvious mental impairment would increasingly become unmanageable. Now that the elites in the Democrat Party, have finally found the courage to slip Biden the shiv, they're already floating fantasy alternative tickets like images of sugar plum fairies. And they're so profoundly arrogant that they think the American public will take all of this at face value. We are now inside the biggest gaslighting job ever - a con-job so big we won't need streetlights for a couple months! Let's review. For the past couple years, any oxygen-breathing person with visual perception knew Joe Biden was mentally impaired and in progressive decline. The entire media knew it, as well as any politico, elected or other, operating in Washington. Many Republicans and independent media verbalized the self-evident truth. However, the ruling Democrat political elite have played the American people as fools for over a year, and with straight faces they think we should play along with their continuing ruse. In a recent article appearing in [The Connecticut Centinal](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001HUSNYBYQzH_YPjc7wnLchuXBXc5lSaqc62JAAPMqw5Z3GBbVfROG5iEzDCknwqNhREvJRyDUuc-29EfLksYy_-j6iRy7UfkGwZj05OSKLbw0ZFE8-SrFNRd1Yi6ozgFiBZ0PKKgNAPXzKDyUdaRlci2u_rI2lIUyryae9Nz0cEWQ3pxIcKwVTPT_uJB552O_4qScQ0qahBXKa8vBd6z6lGCAuRK2rm18Hwq-g3a07iPjFrO3SMXegElrCXqfLUT8_ypT7ezoKj1Ya0MSVVuSqA==&c=O57ecCAa6PHN-VyoPdeM5-tSv6lBtZeCj9zmpmS13VxmmmewkmIfbw==&ch=2gMkECR4gcqbMSMmFRv-oemQ_5AlqScQx0RXzUokE9wFdMAJMwMxvw==), I warned that the leftist Democrat politico-media machine are continually shaping the political battlefield to their advantage, and cautioned Republicans not to play into their traps. Everything we've seen on talking-head TV in the last 24 hours is a perfect example. All the Democrat mouthpieces, echoed by much of the corporate media are focused on Joe Biden's selfless "step-down," immediately followed by endless handicapping of any one of a dozen replacements vs. Donald Trump. They then engage Republicans, or those in the Republican or Conservative camp to join in on the replacement and handicapping game. It's all a massive deception. They want us to ignore the massive fraud they've perpetrated upon the entire country, and simply engage with their parlor game while the weeks tick off toward their convention and beyond. Jim Himes called on Biden to 'bow out," purely for political calculations, instead of calling for the 25th Amendment to be invoked for presidential incapacitation. I called Himes out for his years of deceiving his constituents in this [Article](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001HUSNYBYQzH_YPjc7wnLchuXBXc5lSaqc62JAAPMqw5Z3GBbVfROG5ihSXl8xLfNw0H4AXa2M5dALyWhNn6JSNcHy8BKyecsLiqHZ92rkKXSGNJRtIHSCQx-qjE2sRnZ4in8Ddv8j-RjV0NqnflRPi8Wj24g_u1hXNokB3BdzJKQw330gz0N520qqsV7-Ee-6NmIW-4Iuc4ElP0CDQhTX2o6KKpqphqHu-rgoVRDqZkBPYU9HQy7MKHgSj7Hpf410iDO34H7ewMnzeS_Ma5k8GKtm0tntyckd1ZoRsFkk3vGNeZCa6Hcpp-lEKuaCj2h3&c=O57ecCAa6PHN-VyoPdeM5-tSv6lBtZeCj9zmpmS13VxmmmewkmIfbw==&ch=2gMkECR4gcqbMSMmFRv-oemQ_5AlqScQx0RXzUokE9wFdMAJMwMxvw==). Surely he'll be called on, or will issue a statement chortling about the Biden years, noting Biden's last selfless act. Let's be clear - the best way for Republicans to respond to this entire subversive charade is to stick to reality. And remind the public of every bit of it each time a microphone is put in front of a Republican, or a spokesperson from the Right. Democrats should be castigated endlessly for deceiving the American public for over a year with their dangerous, national-security-threatening ruse of leaving an obviously incapacitated man in the presidency. Republicans should be calling for the 25th Amendment, and in myriad ways should be calling on the American electorate to penalize the Democrats for putting the country in this perilous state for the past year - all to satisfy their addiction to power. If Republicans were to unite from a messaging perspective, the way Democrats always do, they could motivate a seismic landslide for Republicans across the board in November. The political battlefield couldn't be shaping up more favorable for us - if only we would just call out the reality of it all with a united front, a strong voice, and a relentless fight. That's how I've been running my race - and you can be sure that's how I'll continue to prosecute the case against Jim Himes. I'd be honored with your vote in the August 13th Primary.
Jim Himes is NO Moderate
Let's finally end the Jim Himes chapter and return the citizens of CT-4 to their rightful seat at the table.
Please recirculate this to all who are interested, or should be. Thank you all so very much. In liberty,

body:
We’ve been told our whole lives to eat certain fruits, vegetables, and whole grains to stay in good health.

We've been told our whole lives to eat certain fruits, vegetables, and whole grains to stay in good health.
However, according to Dr. Steven Gundry — a world-renowned heart surgeon — many so called **" health foods" in the American diet contain a dangerous toxin, that could be expanding your waistline.**
**" This toxin causes micro-tears to form in your fragile intestinal-wall — allowing bacteria and waste products to seep into your body."** Says Dr. Gundry.
This harmful condition is best known as "leaky gut," and it's affecting millions of people nationwide. **Warning signs include weight gain, fatigue, digestive discomfort, stiff, achy joints, and even skin problems.**
Dr. Gundry explains, "**These side effects are often mistaken for normal signs of aging, because leaky gut usually develops over a matter of years, and sometimes even decades. But I can assure you, the damage caused by these so called "health foods" is far from normal."**
The good news is, this problem can be **easily fixed from your own home.**
"It's very simple, you just have to know which foods are actually healthy, and which contain this hidden toxin," he goes on to explain.
By simply eliminating this harmful toxin, Dr. Gundry has seen thousands of his own patients make swift recoveries. (In fact, he even lost 70lbs himself!)
Now, after years of research, Dr. Gundry has decided to release an informative video to the public — free and uninterrupted — showcasing exactly which foods you need to avoid.
"Good health is one of life's toughest obstacles," he explains. "So, if this video can help people achieve that, I'll be thrilled to hear I was of help."
The video has since gone viral, first being shared by users on Facebook, then being featured on news sites like ABC and CBS.
So far, the comments and feedback have been outstanding, with thousands of Americans feeling better than they have in decades.

**" This toxin causes micro-tears to form in your fragile intestinal-wall -- allowing bacteria and waste products to seep into your body."** Says Dr. Gundry.
This harmful condition is best known as "leaky gut," and it's affecting millions of people nationwide. **Warning signs include weight gain, fatigue, digestive discomfort, stiff, achy joints, and even skin problems.**
Dr. Gundry explains, "**These side effects are often mistaken for normal signs of aging, because leaky gut usually develops over a matter of years, and sometimes even decades. But I can assure you, the damage caused by these so called "health foods" is far from normal."**

## Biden Withdraws, Endorses Harris
President Joe Biden [dropped out of the 2024 presidential race](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LHO4yAQBOCnwR0WrDEkBcU17nLtlRZZlmQjAhZGse7tT05x1d-t9K00o_lzW2-BM5fH7_Am31NdA3b-0OokgASzmiH6RAQ0DeS1A23n-TrB8PQmob1qvBDO1qGNqJObtXPukoxLMw7sQYFRDkArpY0bJwA3QbR3pc2ktRZGUeRe2_iqXPqTUv5bP9RGrO8h-2fv2y6mXwIWActxHGO5Y6FjP13AstXMnXEXsJxBkjJh51pOarRzpNLlq5K8n6eMrW67_H7-Zw5ZtoAkG5ag5-vFuqH5uB2cM-_WCaMe78D526j_vM_Hw78AAAD__yILZyI) Sunday and endorsed his vice president, Kamala Harris, to replace him at the top of the ticket. The historic announcement puts the Democratic Party into uncharted waters, with the next steps up to the party's national committee, which will have to decide on how to select a new candidate. [Here's a look at how that process would work](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFu7CAQRb_G7ljBAAYKitdst69NaWEY1hNhY2GyVv4-2tQpr25xjs7HY34EKrQ__4cNfc91DrHTC2fDABioWY3JZ0RAOaIXBsSktZMwrt5GqyeVuAC35MVhzjFKGa1YnELH80geOChuAATnQpmbBDAS0rRwoaQQYlAcE_Xabp-V9r5iLt_1he0W6zYWv_Z-nIP8N8B9gHs4drzO9_UerVMsOMB9oYQ7W0NrdDIsGDvVnb3BLOFWYwv9ZBf1NbVwhcJ6-9oOFu1iIQfBtdMSbVZWRzM5bXk2KSg3Np-Oi0qhczKD4s8tUPnV6n9Henn4CQAA__88mmfk). Though Harris is seen by some as the front-runner, she was not endorsed in statements from two of the party's most influential leaders, [Barack Obama and Nancy Pelosi,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FyrCAYR_GngQ4H_rDgFhS3sdvbpnQQPxcSlB1l1vHtM0md-hRnfh-P8RFyydvzf1jJt6WOIbb8ptEJQMCMhs9-IQJpTl45KHu73TV48rq3S29cL90Usei-N-FuooEFWdg58uwhYaQDlJTKuE4DTmO2k1RGK6WYkTTnVvfus-atJVrKVd-0d7GuvPjU2utg-h_DwDCc59ldIdX6UxmGjc6DYZjCHuKXqFNYg9jCFi_xolKPLKbakoC8WQVpdZfaWvju59eZS8mHdczI5xpy-b21v-1vj-8AAAD__6sHWao) who both applauded Biden's decision but pointedly didn't endorse his vice president. Obama said [he was confident](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLvO4yAQhZ8Gd0QwJiYuKLahy7ZbWoMZx2y4WEAS5e1X3vrvjnQuOvr-3Jc7hhjy4zcmMn0rC649vGnRHICDWtTgzUYENA5kpAY5Xa_zCMNuZjXPqPxEm3NOjxMSSFzdTaG6ST-7IRgQoIQGkEJIpS8jgB7BT05INUopmRLkQy_18reE3Hfa4re8qV7WkoZo9t6PxsZfDCwDm79Haf20GNhzmIEV-tSSgX01nunTGFiHFdcnLw4Tcl-o5c4p-1Ib8ScmjMh3rDU03vDbuKfU-CfEyI9w1l69dcw-5AfPJYVMxMAO1fjjDIU2aabEI2GI_1_2n5m9DfwLAAD__3MHbrA) "_the leaders of our party will be able to create a process from which an outstanding nominee emerges_." Biden's decision came after weeks of pressure from other Democrats after his poor performance in the June debate with former President Donald Trump. The last time an incumbent president withdrew from an election was in 1968, when Lyndon Johnson announced [he wouldn't run for re-election](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGurCAQxvGnwU4DA8paUNyGbm97SoMwrrNBMMou2bc_cevT_YrJ5J_v5z7dHUVKj_9uQ1OWPDlf6I2TbgFaUJNqglkQAWWDRmgQQ9-PEprV9FLN_U3PYRTgxz7MDnsXOJ-XwXMxioYMcFBcAwjOhdKdBNASwjBzoaQQgimOgUo-umemVFZc4ie_8eh83ppo1lL2k8l_DCwDW2vtXqcrObjPdcDAniUfHwY2YT0Z2D1HKuQvYkRfKKfLVwQDy_VlwcDOFDC1lcoaDlddbHd3uBgxnm2cn61LKb-Sxw1TacU43BhYrdTIb1Lx75fmMGGvFCOdg2aKPzZH8Rtd_p7wbeA3AAD__2CzcG0). Ironically, that year's Democratic convention was in Chicago, just as this year's will be.
## Trump Shooter Flew Drone Over Site
New details have emerged about the attempted assassination of former President Donald Trump, including confirmation of reports that the Secret Service [rejected numerous requests](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGOpDAQBNCvMZmR3faM5wIHl5DNpRciY5rBI4PZdgPav1-xm25Y0pOqVP-f_TOknNbXv7Cg56n0IXI6sHcSQILtbTP6CRHQNOi1A32_3f4YaGYPDwfWaGduJo7OqGmyOAzh8dAKbBxskzwosMoBaKW0da0BcAbG-6C0NVprYRWOiQu175JWnnHKn-VAamNZmuxn5q0K81dAJ6A7z7PlGV97oDGF9TICur3KFc8qoAvEKWYU0F2tArr3nq-gf1TFSMiyIh0poiR8Y2Qc5UZ4pLJXybQvm2QMiyT82LFylVMhuRS6eC07RayScCvEtSE_bmfKOdW7E1a9lpDy927-_cXDw1cAAAD__3Cbdhg) from the campaign for more agents and resources. Officials also said that the shooter, Thomas Matthew Crooks, [flew a drone over the rally site](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGu4yAQAL_G7ojYXWxCQXFNulx7pQV4SThhY5m9RPf3T3n1K0fTjObPfbmHUsv--B029pLbEpKUFy9WISo0ixlXn5mRaWQPFmGeJkc4Pn1yCG5CjkjWuGSIXY6UiYJBZtZj8ajRaIsIWoOxF0K0hOscNRgCgMFoXou08_K3lV2enOv_9uLzkto2Vv8UOfpAvwa8DXgLx87v_lEfOKWkygPe5Py3HSr0Hnove5DSdhVEeDtErWfbWeVYlCW6ArDGCDxrt_IcXEw05TleExgYT78e71Jr6bMdjH5sodTvDPl5ysvjVwAAAP__f5FiUg) prior to the event and that the FBI has found the remains of the drone. The 20-year-old gunman was shot in the head by a Secret Service agent immediately after the shooting. Meanwhile, Trump's campaign [released an update](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAUheGnsTeiywUDHhi6ZEvXjhaBS0yKwcI0Ud6-SueOR99y9H9dlotLOZXbp9vI9lgX53t60KIZIkO5yDHYSIQkRrJcI1fTNAscV2umKYpZGSM1RBBhJgQB3hBqgZLUmCwCStCIHIBLfRL4pqCuwKXgnA8SKKRe2-leU-krxfyqD2onX7cx27X3_RjEx4DnAc9uL_Q83vQerSefacBzbz_bzlot5cXuzn8ftbBjrbWncmMbheRdZo322jqjeXJojPFhIroqaRCCik6b-QpCKjE2G_ZnyjkdSg8SbptL-e9M_z_Nw-JvAAAA__86J2Pl) on the former president's ear injury, stating that the bullet came "less than a quarter of an inch from entering his head" and "produced a 2 cm wide wound."
## AI 'Griefbots' Under Scrutiny
If you had the chance to talk to a loved one who died, would you take it? That's the question asked by "[Eternal You](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFyhCAUAL8GOxx4oNwVFGnsLm1Kh4Pn3UsQDKLGv8_k6vQ7Ozv7cRtvjiKlx7ub0dYpj85X2nE0HICDHnUT7IQIqBq00oDsu-6qoHlaf_dgpk5OHtFdwAd374O7XIIAKbxQDVkQoIUBkEJIbVoFYBSE_i6kVlJKpgUGqrm0n5lSfeIUz7xjaX2em2iftS4rU28MBgbDcRzt6gtiCo7i-ccwGBIeK4NhojjzOe84Y6r8y6W8nPwljSd3_nujgnzdUnDJI8dUy8mxYkku8jNvHH983FbakcHQyWundd-6UslHbIoNy0Ex0tobpsVjdhRfhfX_X7uF3wAAAP__5ERwIg)," a new documentary about artificial intelligence's ability to mine personal data. The film explores the new industry of digital afterlife services, including so-called AI "griefbots," and will be available on the free library streaming platform Kanopy in early 2025. [Watch the trailer here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7Fu8yAURp8GtlhwL4afgeGXIg-V0o4dLWwuMRUOkYON8vZVMnf9Ph0dne_LePEpp9v106_kaiyjn2s6aDQngBOoUfHgIhEQcnLSgNR9bxH44ryJFsS_vveqN3EmA9YGjJOYrbYQAk8OBChhAKQQUpkOAQxC0JOQCqWUTAkKqZat-ynpVheK-VkO2rq5rDy7pdb7g-F_BgODobXWPcte94le_2vxdV4YDgfDsx7gC_BDNt8Y6Ei-7hsxPL-JbiK-uXBvKef00IYpcV19ym9P_bv6cPAbAAD__9MrV9A). The film examines the implications of using AI tools like ChatGPT and virtual reality apps to simulate deceased loved ones from their written records, speech patterns, and photographs. In the movie, experts and users alike discuss the allure and dangers of these AI simulations. Dear Peter,
In 2008, at the time of the Iraq war, my oldest son, Steve, was attending college on a full scholarship when he called my wife and me to tell us he was joining the Army. You may recall that in 2008, the war was not going well. Every day, there were news reports of Soldiers being killed by roadside bombs. I told him, "Don't sign anything!" I immediately drove five hours to meet him. I asked him, "Steven, why are you doing this? You don't need the money." He replied, "I'm not doing it for the money." I then suggested that we talk to the Air Force. He said that he had already considered that, but he was joining the Army because they would guarantee he could learn a foreign language. I asked him, "What language do you want to learn?" He replied, "Arabic." I told him that if he learned Arabic, they would send him to Iraq. His response was three words: "I know, Dad." Steven joined the Army because he thought it was his duty to serve. Sure enough, after completing his basic and military intelligence training and 18 months of language school, he received orders for Iraq. At that time, I had been out of the military for more than 12 years. I immediately rejoined so that I could serve with my son. In 2010-2011, Steve and I deployed to Iraq. It was an honor to serve on the battlefield with my son; it was terrifying for my wife.

We built our country back after our predecessor left it in shambles -- making historic progress in reducing prescription drug costs, upgrading our nation’s infrastructure, fighting climate change, and more. With the name recognition we've built, nearly $1 million invested over three years, and on the second leg of a two-cycle strategy, precedent shows winning is more than possible; like McDowell, it's now within reach.
Considering unfavorable redistricting in 2022, Bob Lorinser already moved the needle for Democrats by up to five points. Now, the opportunity to finally send Jack Bergman back to Louisiana is palpable.
We just need you. We're ready to win and finally defeat extremism in Northern Michigan and the UP.

-Team Lorinser

# [An officer from the Napoleonic Wars had his pension paid until 1951.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sh0ulg&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Famous Figures](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sh0ulg&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sh0ulg&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| H oratio Nelson is one of Great Britain’s most legendary war heroes. The Royal Navy vice admiral led several key victories during the Napoleonic Wars with France — including his final battle near Cape Trafalgar in Spain, where he died after being shot by a sniper. At the time, it was not unusual for the British government to grant perpetual pensions to the families of war heroes, and Nelson’s family was given £5,000 a year, upwards of £500,000 today. The practice ended in 1887, and most families receiving such pensions took a buyout offer soon after. But the pension reserved for the Earls Nelson (the family was given the title of earl in honor of the naval hero) didn’t end until 1951, [with the death of the fifth earl](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sh0ulg&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com). By the 1940s, most of the pension money was used to maintain the family estate, which the family wished to sell but was not able to since it had been purchased with public funds after Horatio’s death. So in 1947, the British Parliament voted to end the arrangement — the family wouldn’t receive a pension, but they’d be allowed to sell the property.
---
It’s somewhat ironic that Nelson’s pension lasted the longest considering it wasn’t actually distributed to his descendants. His beloved daughter Horatia, his only child, was born out of wedlock to his mistress and lifelong love Emma Hamilton — and although he asked with his dying breath that Hamilton be taken care of, his pension went to his older brother William, who did not carry out his wishes. The pension passed down to William’s descendants, and Hamilton raised Horatia in poverty. Given this, one member of Parliament, Michael Foot, speculated that Horatio himself would have voted to end the pension. While discussing the bill in Parliament, [he said](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sh0ulg&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com): “This House, 140 years ago, behaved meanly towards the memory of Lady Hamilton, and when there is a vote [to end the pension], it will be a vote to wipe out the wrong which was done 140 years ago.”
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sh0ulg&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) | [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sh0ulg&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

## Horatio Nelson made up an elaborate backstory for his daughter.
Although they weren’t married in the eyes of the law, Horatio Nelson and Emma Hamilton wanted to raise their only child, Horatia, together. So they told an elaborate lie to lessen the scandal, claiming Horatia had been born several weeks before her actual birthday, a date when Hamilton was out of town, to give her an alibi. They claimed she was an orphan whose father had been a sailor and mother had died in childbirth. According to the story, Nelson and Hamilton raised the child as “godparents.” Nelson eventually claimed Horatia as his own just before her fifth birthday. He left a letter for her on his desk before his death, which he signed off with “receive, my dearest Horatia, the affectionate parental blessing of your father.” Although Hamilton continued to raise the child, she stubbornly maintained the fabricated backstory for the rest of her life.

JULY 22, 2024
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
CONTACT: Houston Keene
press@nancyforalaska.com

Nancy Dahlstrom Releases New Ad: Fight

ANCHORAGE, AK - Today, the Nancy Dahlstrom for Alaska campaign released
a new television ad titled "Fight" highlighting how Lt. Governor
Dahlstrom has fought tough battles for Alaskans as the Lieutenant
Governor and Commissioner of Corrections, and when she gets to
Congress, she will work alongside President Donald Trump to secure our
border, fix our economy, and get our country back on track.

WATCH HERE OR BELOW:
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=70367&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=63205>

<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=70367&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=63205>

"Alaskans need someone in Washington, DC who will fight for them and
work with President Trump to get our country back on track. President
Trump endorsed me in my race for Congress because he knows I have a
proven record of fighting for Alaskans and winning, which is exactly
what I will do when I get to Congress," said Lt. Governor Nancy
Dahlstrom.

FULL TRANSCRIPT:

I've always fought tough battles for Alaska that's why I was endorsed
by President Trump.

In the legislature, I fought the Juneau politicians to protect the
dividends and won.

As Commissioner of Corrections, I fought to repeal soft on crime laws
and won.

Now with illegal aliens and fentanyl flooding into Alaska, I'll work
with President Trump to close our border, and we will win.

I'm Nancy Dahlstrom and I approve this message.

body:

| | Dear Friend, I'm excited to share an insightful eBook from the Hoover Institution, "Personal Freedom and the Moral Case for Capitalism." This work explores the deep-seated debates around free-market capitalism and its alternatives, and you can [get your free copy at this link.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z2ag2fh6b2rj2h38vgpjit2gmcaualp16u0lnip8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cdhmcp36cth2bs)

In the eBook, Russell Roberts challenges the common view that capitalism is based on greed and results in inequality. He argues that free-market competition leads to innovation and better outcomes for consumers and workers.

Ayaan Hirsi Ali, drawing from her experiences growing up in socialist Somalia, illustrates how capitalism can enhance personal freedom and improve living standards. Her powerful narrative shows how economic systems shape individual lives.

This eBook is part of the Human Prosperity Project, which offers scholarly analyses of various economic systems and their impacts on prosperity and well-being.

This eBook provides a balanced perspective on why capitalism might be the more humane and effective choice in a time of growing traction for socialist ideas.

| | Dear Friend, I'm excited to share an insightful eBook from the Hoover Institution, "Personal Freedom and the Moral Case for Capitalism." This work explores the deep-seated debates around free-market capitalism and its alternatives, and you can [get your free copy at this link.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z9a2br009r44ovt5ecf5pf17c2moqdfon4du9br8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cdhm2o31c1h2bs)

In the eBook, Russell Roberts challenges the common view that capitalism is based on greed and results in inequality. He argues that free-market competition leads to innovation and better outcomes for consumers and workers.

Ayaan Hirsi Ali, drawing from her experiences growing up in socialist Somalia, illustrates how capitalism can enhance personal freedom and improve living standards. Her powerful narrative shows how economic systems shape individual lives.

This eBook is part of the Human Prosperity Project, which offers scholarly analyses of various economic systems and their impacts on prosperity and well-being.

This eBook provides a balanced perspective on why capitalism might be the more humane and effective choice in a time of growing traction for socialist ideas.

[Click here to request your free copy of "Personal Freedom and the Moral Case for Capitalism."](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zp1t0mak1qkr4kmqtilqkql95tj3s6j2l3h7b048_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cdhm2o31c1h2bs)

Peter –

I stand with President Biden in wholeheartedly endorsing Vice President Harris as the Democratic nominee and next President of the United States.

She has the vision, leadership, and experience to prosecute the case against Donald Trump, secure victory in November, and hit the ground running from day one to advance our progress.

If you are with me, please consider contributing to Kamala Harris’s campaign today. Every dollar will go directly toward her campaign’s efforts, from hiring staff to running ads in critical swing states.

DONATE >> https://secure.actblue.com/donate/efc-kamala-harris?refcode=em_2024.07.22_fr_7A_efc_b1_all

President Biden has been an incredible and historically successful president. He took us from pandemic to recovery, restored trust in our government, strengthened our alliances, and delivered remarkable results for the American people. His selflessness will be remembered as a true profile in courage.

Vice President Harris will build on his legacy, and I am proud to support her. Now is the time to unite behind her and defeat Trump together.

Sincerely yours,

Eileen

body:

| | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zkrvltu8v5aqs6hilc581s78gmi5ct37jc46lcbg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cdhm2p76cth2bs)

| | Dear Friend, I'm excited to share an insightful eBook from the Hoover Institution, "Personal Freedom and the Moral Case for Capitalism." This work explores the deep-seated debates around free-market capitalism and its alternatives, and you can [get your free copy at this link.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zdchug3l71off7jkr41v5qgvfeppi0cvk1fh7ub0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cdhm2p76cth2bs)

In the eBook, Russell Roberts challenges the common view that capitalism is based on greed and results in inequality. He argues that free-market competition leads to innovation and better outcomes for consumers and workers.

Ayaan Hirsi Ali, drawing from her experiences growing up in socialist Somalia, illustrates how capitalism can enhance personal freedom and improve living standards. Her powerful narrative shows how economic systems shape individual lives.

This eBook is part of the Human Prosperity Project, which offers scholarly analyses of various economic systems and their impacts on prosperity and well-being.

This eBook provides a balanced perspective on why capitalism might be the more humane and effective choice in a time of growing traction for socialist ideas.

[Click here to request your free copy of "Personal Freedom and the Moral Case for Capitalism."](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z2sqkmbhpu66u7qktspch1cebf7mbic6e3dtkh28_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cdhm2p76cth2bs)

Best regards,
Greg Stamps

Hello,
When my husband Adam Frisch ran against Lauren Boebert in 2022, we were the underdogs until the very end.
Adam did not receive any national support. We were heavily out-raised and out-spent by Boebert and her Washington allies.
Ultimately, though, Adam lost in a recount by just 546 votes – the closest race in the entire country.
The worst part is that it wasn’t because we didn’t work hard. Our family, our team, and our volunteers gave it everything we had. We just ran out of money.
In the final weeks of the race, we had to cut back. Right as Boebert was increasing her advertising – right as we _knew_ we were on her heels – we had to pull TV ads, cancel digital buys, and make a lot of hard budget decisions.
Adam might not say it, but I will: If we had had additional resources and been able to fully fund his campaign until the end, Adam would probably be in Congress right now – and Lauren Boebert would be a footnote in a history book.
It’s part of why Adam announced so early that he was running again. We need to make sure that we have the money to build a campaign that can sustain all the way through to November 5, 2024.

clean_body: Adam might not say it, but I will. Hello, When my husband Adam Frisch ran against Lauren Boebert in 2022, we were the underdogs until the very end. Adam did not receive any national support. We were heavily out-raised and out-spent by Boebert and her Washington allies. Ultimately, though, Adam lost in a recount by just 546 votes – the closest race in the entire country. The worst part is that it wasn’t because we didn’t work hard. Our family, our team, and our volunteers gave it everything we had. We just ran out of money. In the final weeks of the race, we had to cut back. Right as Boebert was increasing her advertising – right as we knew we were on her heels – we had to pull TV ads, cancel digital buys, and make a lot of hard budget decisions. Adam might not say it, but I will: If we had had additional resources and been able to fully fund his campaign until the end, Adam would probably be in Congress right now – and Lauren Boebert would be a footnote in a history book. It’s part of why Adam announced so early that he was running again. We need to make sure that we have the money to build a campaign that can sustain all the way through to November 5, 2024. But with Lauren Boebert having run off scared, this race is a lot harder. The Super PACs are already attacking Adam, and he’s not taking any money from corporate PACs. body:
It doesn’t matter who the Democrat nominee is. The only way we win is to work hard.
| | | |

| This weekend, Joe Biden announced he is stepping down from the presidential race and endorsing Kamala Harris as his successor. While this change was somewhat expected, it does not mean we automatically win.
Underestimating the campaign for Kamala Harris would be a colossal mistake. The mainstream media, Hollywood, the government bureaucracy, and every Democrat elected official will work hard to bolster her image and story. They will likely cover for her even more than they did for Joe Biden.
Changing the Democrat nominee does not guarantee a Trump win! It presents a new challenge as the focus shifts from Biden's failures to Harris' failures, especially as the "Border Czar." There's also the possibility the Democrats could replace her with a more favorable candidate.
**The point is, it doesn 't matter who the Democrat nominee is.** Our mission remains the same. We must Get Out The Vote for President Trump! The only way to avoid another election disaster is by overwhelming the polls with Trump votes. This means helping Trump voters make a plan to vote and ensuring they follow through.
**_YOU are the key to this strategy and our victory in November._****_
_****Sign up today at****[MarchToVictory.com](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a3a15c77/1edb9794a3a02cb0 "https://www.teapartypatriots.org/citizensfund/mtv/")****to get involved and help us beat whoever the undemocratic Democrats decide to run for president!****
** This is not going to be easy--this is a battle for our nation, but together, we can do it. God Bless America! Jenny Beth

Together with House Democrats, the Biden-Harris administration passed historic legislation to fix our nation’s crumbling roads and bridges, worked to combat the climate crisis, brought manufacturing jobs home, capped the cost of insulin at $35 per month and delivered bipartisan gun safety for the first time in three decades. The D in Democrat stands for deliver. America is a better place today because President Joe Biden has led us with intellect, grace and dignity. We are forever grateful for President Biden’s legacy, and now, we MUST defend it from extreme MAGA Republicans.

It has been the honor of a lifetime to serve alongside our Commander-in-Chief, my friend, President Joe Biden – one of the finest public servants we will ever know. And I am honored to have his support and endorsement. | | |

I am running to be President of the United States. **It has been the honor of a lifetime to serve alongside our Commander-in-Chief, my friend, President Joe Biden – one of the finest public servants we will ever know. And I am honored to have his support and endorsement.** And I am eager to run on the record of what Joe and I have accomplished together. We built our country back after our predecessor left it in shambles – making historic progress in upgrading our nation’s infrastructure, fighting climate change, and more. We are stronger today because we took action – together – to invest in America’s future. I am excited to continue to work toward our vision for a better future for all. #
Peter — It should be clearer than ever now: We cannot afford six more years of Josh Hawley in the U.S. Senate.
I’ll explain more in a moment. **[But for now, can you please rush a donation of any amount toward my campaign? The U.S. Senate just became more important than ever — and of the few opportunities to flip a seat in 2024, this race is our most affordable chance to defeat a vulnerable Republican incumbent.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59743?refcode=em20240722-7143&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7143%2E614464%2E4DlknD)**

[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59744?refcode=em20240722-7143&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=2&akid=7143%2E614464%2E4DlknD) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59744?refcode=em20240722-7143&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=3&akid=7143%2E614464%2E4DlknD) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59743?refcode=em20240722-7143&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=7143%2E614464%2E4DlknD)
---
Josh Hawley has spent his whole career attacking our freedoms, undermining our democracy, and accumulating power at the expense of the Missourians he was elected to represent. He’s even now openly declared he’ll lead a **“Christian Nationalist”** crusade in Washington — starting in 2025. He’s already shown us what that looks like — can you imagine if he convinced a Senate majority or even a president to back it up?
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59743?refcode=em20240722-7143&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=7143%2E614464%2E4DlknD)
**[FIGHT BACK: CHIP IN →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59743?refcode=em20240722-7143&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=7143%2E614464%2E4DlknD)**
**If we’re able to defeat Hawley and flip Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat this November, it will be a devastating blow to the extremist nationwide crusade against liberty — and we’ll also get one more vote to defend our freedoms, protect our democracy, and take back power for working people.**
And the good news is that we’ve paved a real path to victory.
Our grassroots campaign has outraised Hawley at nearly every single fundraising deadline. We’ve earned the earliest-ever endorsements for a U.S. Senate challenger from the Missouri AFL-CIO and the rest of Missouri’s election-winning labor movement. We’ve turned out thousands of voters across rural, urban, and suburban Missouri at events in every corner of the state. And now in November, we’ll even have a referendum to end Missouri’s abortion ban on the ballot.
**[CHIP IN NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59743?refcode=em20240722-7143&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=7&akid=7143%2E614464%2E4DlknD)**
Hawley won his last race with only 51% of the vote — and that was before anyone had a chance to expose his obsession with controlling our lives. Now, he’s the least popular GOP incumbent Senator up for re-election this year — in the first election since he helped overturn Roe and enact a total abortion ban in Missouri.
**If we can get the truth about Hawley’s record of extremism in front of Missouri voters early and often, I know we can win this race.**
But I’m counting on your help to do it, Peter. So I’m urgently asking:
**[Will you rush a donation of any amount toward my campaign today? As one of the only opportunities we’ve got to flip a GOP-held U.S. Senate seat this year, investing in our race could be your chance to make a real difference in this year’s election — and for the future of our freedoms and democracy.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59743?refcode=em20240722-7143&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=8&akid=7143%2E614464%2E4DlknD)**

Lucas Kunce

| This month, many Vermonters are receiving their new property tax bills. Statewide, because the Super Majority in the Legislature failed to act, Vermonters will face an average increase of approximately 14%. **The Governor, like most Vermonters, believes this is totally unacceptable.**

Unfortunately, the Super Majority in the Legislature disagreed. They believe Vermonters can handle this enormous property tax hike, in addition to the new, nearly $100 million payroll tax they enacted, hundreds of millions more for electricity bills, hundreds or thousands of dollars more per year for Vermonters to heat their homes and businesses, and more.

These are just a handful of examples of the costs this Super Majority in the Legislature has imposed on working families, retirees and small businesses – all over the Governor’s objections.

The Governor has been pushing back, while offering solutions to move us forward. But he can’t do it alone in Montpelier. **We need your help to balance the Legislature and elect more common sense Vermonters who will listen to you, not the special interests and partisan leadership. **

Yesterday, Joe Biden made the patriotic decision to put our democracy first and suspend his presidential campaign.
One thing is clear: Michigan is more important than ever to winning the White House this November. Our ever-so swingy swing state was the tipping point in 2016, the tipping point in 2020, and will likely be the deciding factor once again this November.
It’s no secret that this is a historic moment in our nation’s history and an inflection point in our race: Because the Senate race is the top of the ticket, our performance likely impacts the presidential and vice versa.
But I’ve won three tough elections, so I’m no stranger to responding to big moments in a campaign. In 2020, Supreme Court Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg passed away in September. In 2022, the Supreme Court struck down _Roe v. Wade_.
Both of these moments -- and the one we’re in now — had the potential to shift the future of our country. Our campaign will have to adapt, but that’s what we’re good at.
But we know that this news is also firing up the Republican base. And we need to not only match that enthusiasm but EXCEED it.
We have built a campaign that can win in November, but only with your continued support.

Our ever-so swingy swing state was the tipping point in 2016, the tipping point in 2020, and will likely be the deciding factor once again this November. It’s no secret that this is a historic moment in our nation’s history and an inflection point in our race: Because the Senate race is the top of the ticket, our performance likely impacts the presidential and vice versa. But I’ve won three tough elections, so I’m no stranger to responding to big moments in a campaign. In 2020, Supreme Court Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg passed away in September. In 2022, the Supreme Court struck down Roe v. Wade. Both of these moments -- and the one we’re in now — had the potential to shift the future of our country. Our campaign will have to adapt, but that’s what we’re good at. But we know that this news is also firing up the Republican base. And we need to not only match that enthusiasm but EXCEED it. We have built a campaign that can win in November, but only with your continued support. body:
Peter,

I'm proud to join President Joe Biden in endorsing Kamala Harris for President of the United States.

Harris is a fantastic choice to lead the Democratic ticket. She fought to protect consumers as California's attorney general. She worked to improve public safety as a district attorney. She stood up for our democracy in the Senate. And there has been no more effective champion for reproductive rights than Vice President Harris.

I'm confident Kamala Harris will lead our party to victory in November and continue to do great things for America as our next president. But it’s up to us to make sure she gets there.

Right now, Donald Trump and JD Vance allies up and down the ballot are in the best position they’ve ever been in to flip Minnesota red in November. And if they pull it off, they’ll win the election.

That’s where we come in. Our decades-strong grassroots movement has always played a critical role in activating hard-to-reach voters, boosting Democratic turnout, and keeping Minnesota blue.

| Peter,

President Joe Biden has demonstrated extraordinary leadership in choosing to put the future of our country before personal or political ambition, and I will forever be grateful to him for his leadership, his example, and his devotion to our country.

From the earliest days of his presidency, he has led our country towards a stronger future, working with Congress to pass generationally-important legislation — the bipartisan infrastructure law, the _CHIPS & Science Act_, the _Inflation Reduction Act_ , and the _Honoring our PACT Act_ , among so many others. As the leader of the free world, he has rallied our allies in support of democracy and freedom, and here at home, he has been unwavering in his belief in our country and his commitment to the American people.

Peter,

I have immense respect and gratitude for President Joe Biden’s leadership and dedication to our country. His decision to step aside is a testament to his selflessness and commitment to the greater good of our nation.

Vice President Kamala Harris has consistently demonstrated her unwavering dedication to justice, equality, and the American people. Her vision for our future is one that I wholeheartedly believe in and support.

I am honored to endorse Vice President Kamala Harris as the Democratic nominee for President. Her leadership, experience, and steadfast dedication to our shared values make her the ideal candidate to guide our nation forward.

As a delegate to the Democratic National Convention, I enthusiastically support Vice President Harris's nomination for President. Let’s unite behind Vice President Harris to create a more inclusive and brighter future for all Americans.

Part of supporting Vice President Harris will be ensuring that she has a strong Democratic Senate standing behind her in the White House. Our team is energized and enthusiastic to build our campaign even further over the coming months, and we’re looking forward to standing with fellow Democrats working to make our country stronger together.

In Unity,

_Ty Pinkins_

* * *
| The son of a tractor driver, Ty doesn’t come from a wealthy family. He was born and raised in the small town of Rolling Fork, and is a proud son of the Mississippi Delta.

Frustrated by the lack of action from lawmakers on the issues facing people in Mississippi–and believing that the hard-working voters of Mississippi deserve much better–Ty Pinkins decided to run for office: the United States Senate in 2024.

name: Lizzie Pannill Fletcher
subject: Gratitude and Hope for President Biden and Vice President Harris
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
Yesterday was eventful and emotional as President Biden announced that he would step aside as the Democratic nominee for President in the 2024 election.
President Biden has been an extraordinary president, and his historic accomplishments will deliver meaningful results for Americans for generations to come. From responding with urgency and vision to the coronavirus pandemic, to leading the largest infrastructure investment in our country in nearly a century, to bringing back domestic manufacturing and investment in our supply chains and our scientific leadership, to restoring the United States’ leadership in the world and partnerships with allies abroad, President Biden’s leadership and vision has set the country on a better course for the future. I am grateful for his steadfast leadership, his decades of patriotic service, and his unwavering commitment to America and Americans.
His announcement yesterday reflects his patriotism. Once again, he has put the American people and our future ahead of all else. And he continues to lead us forward by endorsing Vice President Kamala Harris as the Democratic nominee for President in 2024. As I announced yesterday, I am honored and proud to join President Biden in endorsing Vice President Kamala Harris for President.

I have worked with Vice President Harris on some of the most important issues facing our community and country, especially in her work leading efforts to restore and protect the reproductive health and freedom of American women. I have faith in her and her ability to lead and unite Americans now and in the future, and I look forward to working with you and with people across the country to help her win in November.
Will you join me in supporting Vice President Harris? Less than 24 hours into Vice President Harris’ campaign, we’ve seen Democrats rally behind her. Fellow American,

We are witnessing a chilling assault on America's unborn. Led by none other than Vice President Kamala Harris, who has become the unabashed champion of Planned Parenthood and the ruthless abortion industry.

Recently, during a stop on her Fight for Reproductive Freedom Tour, she declared "Let us understand the horrific reality that women face every single day since the _Roe_ decision was overturned." So many Americans don't realize that she's essentially proclaiming open support for unrestricted access to abortion **-- even painful abortions in the second and third trimester that _Roe_ allowed.**

This is not about 'Reproductive Freedom'; this is a war for the fabric of our nation.

A war sanctioned by those in the highest corridors of power against the most innocent among us. Our future generations are under attack because of Kamala's obsession with Planned Parenthood and the death of the innocent.

Because of Kamala's blatant disregard for human life, we will not hesitate or back down from the opportunity to serve women and save babies.

At SBA Pro-Life America we stand against this monstrous assault on life. We relentlessly work to counter the abortion industry's destructive forces and advocate for vulnerable mothers and innocent babies who cannot speak for themselves--the unborn.

**Your support is their last line of defense and with the 2024 election around the corner, we must act swiftly and decisively. **

The future of America's unborn is in jeopardy and their fate rests with you -- voters who can elect leaders who honor the sanctity of life.

Now is your moment to rise against the rabid abortion extremism of Kamala Harris and her allies by standing with SBA Pro-Life America and ensuring more pro-life voters stand for life.

[Donate today and join us in this decisive battle to safeguard the unborn, and ensure LIFE triumphs in 2024 and beyond!](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=e0a2a7d7edf14c16a3f4d28c5aeb626b&_e=MLcO3u3F1LaOOLgBL8UaFK6gkZFv8yCUcPvm5er9s1VG-VoyJvdxUw7hICW1AXHdqNuBRBdnFMiMD90T74LRl5e6NZ0glpmPamFt8aT463rZD8GnUH60C1kncLRzKiYUPWaXaAggA4G7dKsR9JRKNycEILrP1Qj47LtWHWPBsl8lOPzWYW57LG90569M7UlVH7aDszNB6_kRmRFYuuM-ETq50T70fluPb54WZVZDndOl1Vo3trP4Ai0L84hyvmVofqT36yKH-m5DPGb36q2L4Q_TNpc-4cAXASgO75zr-QLdT2u0GsBxett8Vqpb-3RRTve-I2QZD5NeWtVDgUmieHDDMMtGuOOBB_RjFLcrhiBWtwV9mQipr-D373Nam5VVjZ9VG2eIioZ2FVQwCy29zg%3D%3D)

Marjorie Dannenfelser

# **In it to win it.**
---
| | | | Hello folks, Thank you for stepping up and answering the call to action with overwhelming positivity. Your support means everything to us. Kamala Harris has boldly stepped up to champion the wishes of the American people: electing the first Asian and African American Female President in U.S. history.
