name: Andrew Yang
subject: Joe Biden is Out – What’s Next?
body:
Joe Biden did the right thing for the country on Sunday and dropped out of the presidential race. We should all be grateful. | |
---
| | |
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=9b863f60c7&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
---
|
---
| Joe Biden did the right thing for the country on Sunday and dropped out of the presidential race. We should all be grateful. It was an admirable thing to do.

Joe quickly turned around and endorsed Kamala Harris as the new nominee, and the campaign has already rebranded as “Harris for President.” Kamala announced her intent to win the nomination at the Democratic National Convention that begins on August 19th. A small legion of Democrats immediately endorsed her.

Technically, the roughly 4,000 DNC delegates can choose whomever they want as the new nominee. However, having been pledged to Joe Biden they are likely to adhere to his wishes. And the past several weeks have drained many Democrats of their desire to hold a competitive mini-primary. If Joe had dropped out 10 days earlier or so, it might have seemed more enticing.

I think a mini-primary would be the best path forward for multiple reasons. First, the nominee needs vetting. You want to put forth the strongest possible candidate. Second, it would get massive levels of attention for the new generation; who wouldn’t tune in to see who the Dems put forth? Third, I think pulling the party together afterwards against Trump would be very easy and straightforward. If your problem has been the anointment of Joe Biden, try to learn from that and avoid repeating the same mistake.
---
|
---
| The problem is that other candidates are looking at this situation and clearing the path for Kamala. Their calculation is this: do I run against the sitting Vice President backed by the President in a compressed time frame and get accused of trying to elbow aside the logical next person up? Or do I sit this one out, maybe get into the Veepstakes for Kamala and bide my time until 2028? Most are quickly choosing the latter.

Barack Obama notably recommended a more robust and open process. But his voice has been outweighed by others who are trying to push for quickly coalescing around Kamala. Look for a constant stream of Kamala endorsements from delegates and superdelegates in the coming days, making a challenge to her all-the-more daunting.

Here’s the fundamental problem: I don’t believe Kamala Harris is the strongest candidate against Donald Trump.

Kamala has consistently polled as quite unpopular and has some of the disadvantages of incumbency – she can still be blamed for whatever people haven’t liked about the last several years. Her previous presidential campaign in 2019 underperformed.

When I’ve been asked over the past number of weeks who I thought might be the strongest candidates, I suggested a Gretchen Whitmer – Josh Shapiro ticket that would likely net the Democrats both Michigan and Pennsylvania. I also think that Andy Beshear, Roy Cooper, Wes Moore and others would perform quite well. You could put another half-dozen or so names in here and I wouldn’t disagree, nor would polling. My instinct has been that the country wants someone new and would vote accordingly.

Kamala Harris at 59 is a vastly better bet than Joe Biden at 81. I’m glad it’s not Joe. But if you’re going to go through the trouble of removing your nominee, you should go all the way and try to give yourself the best possible chance of victory. Isn’t that the point?

[Forward](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=9596ab8836&e=0f227c2ae3) is endorsing candidates around the country – check them out [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=08753aebe6&e=0f227c2ae3)! Let’s build the Party of the Future that we clearly need.
---
| **
Andrew Yang**
Co-Chair, Forward Party

Hiring staff, recruiting and training volunteers, equipping them with the very best technology to identify our voter and secure their vote by November 5th. There's no time to lose. In closing, I can't help but think how Adam Schiff and his team of high-priced DC consultants thought they were being savvy in trying to make sure I became their opponent in General Election. Reports are they even spent money running ads promoting me. But what they've really done is awaken a sleeping giant here. Remember, before it became a wasteland of crime, homelessness, and sky-high taxes, California was a land of dreamers, a land of opportunity. It was a place where a scrawny little kid could start as a bat boy for his heroes, work hard, win a World Series, and land on a Topps baseball card. California can be that place again. America can be that place again. And it starts with throwing out political liars and connivers like Adam Schiff and reclaiming our freedom roots. Time is the most important factor. Thank you!

Peter, I had my team send you the video below as an alert, but this message bears repeating: _**[**On July 1, thousands of violent offenders became eligible for reduced sentences, many of whom are high risk for violent reoffending.**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=442bb2971ed6448398e7669365cf8ea4&_e=pmQEbngN5ObFMl5qE9V0n9b0Iv8CGmn6EuxLWD-72L4hGX2LmTUqtrPLChFBhJKK2FQ6QoLuZyy0EMYODi3LJ2jMlziWLKZOX1Vp16Jp-MiSM0Au_RMrT10JlGQZJTFIq8E1HGUPThjqm1IO-E5YBMQt2yzPlYiW1pX-G-XR9MxtnJYjEEMvnP51cqD40c6qJBZgf87D73lY34PY9AE_QkQ1x0F3QOWqQKcL8261zvECFVcl-_pO5Q_9VvcAIU9j85LqK97DleeHYoUc6U6OJPGeaAkbxSRDUNMNwXi-DrkMl__pDfQ_j0E55mxwq0c-QwB-fXr1xffM6hKgvNpTl1Cjy0ilIfLrLnDSA5ii84f8dZ2u78GqQzEd2ScOt8e-RFmKsRdM51BQwmnQ7-a5-x9qbFl60y69E_-6cp4vL57Kt1KUrLt4CiHdSHL7skpz)**_ We’re talking about individuals convicted of 1st-degree murder, rape, robbery, and abduction. I believe in redemption, but reducing sentences for violent criminals is not justice. _**If you do the crime, you must do the time.**_ It's well known that a mere 2-5% of offenders are responsible for over 50% of all crime. Expanding earned sentence credits to inmates convicted of both violent and nonviolent offenses in the same act or transaction will likely benefit these repeat, violent offenders. **Virginians should not have to wait for a tragedy to prompt their elected officials to prioritize their safety. Good intentions do not equal good results.**

This wasn’t my policy, nor Governor Youngkin’s policy. This was a law passed under the previous governor, with his far-left allies and their “criminals first, victims last mindset.” Time and time again, I pleaded with the General Assembly to fix this system before it went into effect. They rejected those pleas...and now here we are. But I’m not giving up. My office is monitoring this situation and working with local law enforcement because your family’s safety is our number one priority. **_[Please, watch the whole video, and if you’re so inclined, donate to support our campaign’s fundraising goal. We’re standing up for law and order against a General Assembly full of bad ideas on crime...and we need you with us to keep fighting.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=442bb2971ed6448398e7669365cf8ea4&_e=pmQEbngN5ObFMl5qE9V0n9b0Iv8CGmn6EuxLWD-72L4hGX2LmTUqtrPLChFBhJKK2FQ6QoLuZyy0EMYODi3LJ2jMlziWLKZOX1Vp16Jp-MiSM0Au_RMrT10JlGQZJTFIq8E1HGUPThjqm1IO-E5YBMQt2yzPlYiW1pX-G-XR9MxtnJYjEEMvnP51cqD40c6qJBZgf87D73lY34PY9AE_QkQ1x0F3QOWqQKcL8261zvECFVcl-_pO5Q_9VvcAIU9j85LqK97DleeHYoUc6U6OJDQgbgnlCLRKHA3lRaEJNGgArPC5al_moB_ZCwKhrkT6g2zjeJbUfaq8T4W_bBSqOFSPnJJHRUVQo6BGu2gt9yqbmCDTrQ34Z4Nk0zw8gELPBVA1WuEChtzCG5mc23zRTM0rZCqE_WNsSSevUUBQ2E9i_p0U1XIGl1QxF0ERLE0e)_ **

name: Lena Moffitt, Evergreen
subject: VP Harris is the climate champion we need
disclaimer_text: paid for by Evergreen Action
body:
She is ready to seize this moment
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2708910/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| Hi—

Vice President Harris has a long track record of standing up for climate and environmental justice: |
---
|
* As Vice President, she cast the deciding vote to pass the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA), unleashing billions of dollars to build the clean energy future we need, and has traveled the country standing up for good union jobs.

* As the second highest ranking official in the most climate-accomplished administration in US history, her leadership has been central to initiatives that are changing peoples' lives for the better around the country.

* As a Senator from California, she introduced the Climate Equity Act, paving the way for the equity investments made in the IRA and has been a leading voice for environmental justice her entire career.

* As California's Attorney General, she took big oil to court and won—siding with communities against their polluting projects and forcing them to clean up their messes.

* As District Attorney for San Francisco, she established one of the first environmental justice units in the country

In 2004, I received my commission in the U.S. Army and graduated with a Bachelor of Science degree in Leadership and Management with a Field of Study in Mechanical Engineering. After West Point, I spent eight years in the Army as an Aviation Branch Officer and AH-64D Apache Longbow helicopter pilot.

[](http://links.wesleyhunttx.com/u/click?_t=6aa969a792e549699e2a6024aa3e4ace&_m=823b2f9530314d799b4ecddd0ef31c7d&_e=YFqJGjUPk2vcbd7IJvwfLxRjoLQ50OKDVM35PfcAQIiO4sD8HFRbeQgsiW1jNNzpJlCSsBNUeFkAiXHiAmgmGUjBdI-EGSfu276GG9k2LcWJaCvnocH0Pvb-Zzb5MRv6RkuNGR1eBuwOPPg9FocP2gZ0MEz10qQ43N4V8Pq3Ra_ppodzRV-3fgGNdHjFSf7Gxfifvb7EevdxqdjH1mC8imXKDuof42KRnGCW5CmotDEz8eL0BQOWxRhVRF9XagEUDfqfd_6K2Dvg6mTo4FXhtnrabfp_z3iY16ym32J7Y2JizFerbZZpVA6ol70A0gbS)
I'm proud to share that my service included one combat deployment to Iraq, and two deployments to Saudi Arabia where I served as a Diplomatic Liaison Officer.

After honorably discharging as a Captain, I attended Cornell University and earned a Master of Business Administration (M.B.A.), a Master of Public Administration (M.P.A.) and a Master of Industrial and Labor Relations (M.I.L.R.).

I never believed that changing Washington would be easy, but graduating from West Point and serving in the United States Army, being deployed to combat zones, and flying Apache helicopters over Iraq has prepared me for tough fights and big challenges. I truly believe nothing is more worth fighting for than our great country and our way of life in the Houston area.

My family is everything to me. My wife Emily and I have two daughters and one son, Victoria, Olivia and Willie Parish Hunt 2nd.

[](http://links.wesleyhunttx.com/u/click?_t=6aa969a792e549699e2a6024aa3e4ace&_m=823b2f9530314d799b4ecddd0ef31c7d&_e=YFqJGjUPk2vcbd7IJvwfLxRjoLQ50OKDVM35PfcAQIiO4sD8HFRbeQgsiW1jNNzpJlCSsBNUeFkAiXHiAmgmGUjBdI-EGSfu276GG9k2LcWJaCvnocH0Pvb-Zzb5MRv6RkuNGR1eBuwOPPg9FocP2gZ0MEz10qQ43N4V8Pq3Ra9n4hhFV1XwaYcuQBWKZLXd5AwRI2ckkdZGLaMg7JhE8Ro3wUEM_r6CzddW8UPG3PJL4T4QUSZ-9zabJfL_Sia9SvoJql0Ks64dH8McqnBQIf21m9TuwvKCm-PvZzcUWSTbsHiD-KAimSq8YPoNU4eY)

President Biden's decision to put our country first
| | |
---
Friend —

I’ll keep this short, but I wanted to reach out in light of yesterday’s news. President Biden has made the decision to put our country first, and has withdrawn from the presidential election. I want to thank the president for his life of public service, and for honoring that legacy with his decision yesterday.
Let’s be clear: Our country is at a crossroads, and the election this November could be the end of democracy as we know it. Rick Scott is one of the architects of the GOP’s catastrophic vision for America, and a Scott-led Senate is one of the greatest threats to progress. It has never been more important that we organize and work hard to reach every voter, tell them what’s at stake on November 5, and get them to the polls.

We must stand united against the attacks on our freedoms and democracy. This election will come down to whether we can unify as Americans to protect our values, freedoms, and opportunities of this incredible nation, or whether we allow extreme right-wing politicians to take control for power and self-enrichment.
Together, I am confident we can preserve American democracy and protect the American dream that I and so many others have lived — **_[but that work starts now, with grassroots support to elect Democrats up and down the ballot.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89339708/486968286/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1589-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODIzMmY5YzEtNDI0OC1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=SsTGPSotTnvuAh9xAmOxKwKsWe7Lhf1CMMgAhDoZtiQ=)_**

| | Dear Friend, I'm excited to share an insightful eBook from the Hoover Institution, "Personal Freedom and the Moral Case for Capitalism." This work explores the deep-seated debates around free-market capitalism and its alternatives, and you can [get your free copy at this link.](https://email.republicanmajority.net/c/eJyM0b2O2zAMB_CnkTcFEqXI9uDhACNbgqJLR4EnMY4KfRiSckXfvnDTFh1vJYkf_yC_Xe0VQwx5u2GipSZbm81oH6V8UOX3SuRL4jlZEKC5GDmAVYNfzAzjJAda5AjSmHnW0_BYwJ-1QCP1_A5GjNqdRy-8kGdHgJP2Q1gOR4wA0ggp4SQmCaPBGe5ABOc706LS_nyPwWFO-L3U0H-eMvUhLo_e98bUG4MLg0ulVp7VUTu9wp5K3RhcdqqtZIz_smP2vD-Ip1IxcoeN-L1U7nAPHWNo6eDU5dmTfYFMrXstbSfXQ94YmKOVyIdnYmqlhCH-KTpMO4YtM7X-1u2h2__l11jJnXJnar3d7Jc3_vXK_16BgSnRMbWqWU16qIvff4QYQzMj02I7dp1cSUP_9Gs-FvgVAAD__6c-mOo)

In the eBook, Russell Roberts challenges the common view that capitalism is based on greed and results in inequality. He argues that free-market competition leads to innovation and better outcomes for consumers and workers.

Ayaan Hirsi Ali, drawing from her experiences growing up in socialist Somalia, illustrates how capitalism can enhance personal freedom and improve living standards. Her powerful narrative shows how economic systems shape individual lives.

This eBook is part of the Human Prosperity Project, which offers scholarly analyses of various economic systems and their impacts on prosperity and well-being.

This eBook provides a balanced perspective on why capitalism might be the more humane and effective choice in a time of growing traction for socialist ideas.

[Click here to request your free copy of "Personal Freedom and the Moral Case for Capitalism."](https://email.republicanmajority.net/c/eJyM0b2O2zAMB_CnkTcFEqXI9uDhACNbgqJLR4EnMY4KfRiSckXfvnDTFh1vJYkf_yC_Xe0VQwx5u2GipSZbm81oH6V8UOX3SuRL4jlZEKC5GDmAVYNfzAzjJAda5AjSmHnW0_BYwJ-1QCP1_A5GjNqdRy-8kGdHgJP2Q1gOR4wA0ggp4SQmCaPBGe5ABOc706LS_nyPwWFO-L3U0H-eMvUhLo_e98bUG4MLg0ulVp7VUTu9wp5K3RhcdqqtZIz_smP2vD-Ip1IxcoeN-L1U7nAPHWNo6eDU5dmTfYFMrXstbSfXQ94YmKOVyIdnYmqlhCH-KTpMO4YtM7X-1u2h2__l11jJnXJnar3d7Jc3_vXK_16BgSnRMbWqWU16qIvff4QYQzMj02I7dp1cSUP_9Gs-FvgVAAD__6c-mOo)

---
| |
Dear Friend of Knowledge, Are you struggling with a difficult question in your life? Often, I find myself in that position as well. It's part of the human condition to be faced with difficult situations, choices, and people. We teach at Hillsdale College that we must carefully consider concepts such as morality, ethics, happiness, courage, character, and justice when we face difficult questions. In the _Nicomachean Ethics_ --the first book written on how best to live--Aristotle argues that human happiness chiefly depends upon a person's character, which is formed by making good choices. But good choices don't come naturally. That's why every student at Hillsdale studies Aristotle. In fact, understanding Aristotle is so important to living a good life that we've produced our online course, **" Introduction to Aristotle's _Ethics_ : How to Lead a Good Life." **
---
| | And now you can own the course on DVD, along with a special Hillsdale College edition of Aristotle's _Nicomachean Ethics_ , for personal study. You'll not only study what Aristotle says about the good life with Hillsdale College President Larry P. Arnn, but you will also explore ways to put this knowledge to work.
---
| [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1b4309e1b1ec44cfb394caf3802f7873&_e=3gaoah_9tRAdtnbBuQUM40M5xmpmd8sMyWIZg6FqbZ17RUHNh3IIybgLa5rSb0jCckXJ4-xvrpJMl350amfXVdu9vumZ2UNf4T1x_bpv_vN93nz7LOnBu3By-DAiMAmXncv4ZmVF871kl-W1SDXg79a3CCnipRpMwWAri4mNWYIRfeHNgIjdVOWdb2LXg9aKqGLDwy_lGaf8iWFdBeBSfzZxQWrZZTHVBnP_pQ0UrO3pqIDzfbAwOZTZvC5BvifPe0hWMshffl35xxHvjqXyCcMByMK_eQZou8_5m3b1H2mkmvvTvthF6O1woiJsz5IeaHO8beH7hu5F4YRpmKxCHB-v0xdTwl5v6Ko7QloHQhG6mOwbrzYN0yktsmxqIrE8xhQyq8F6Jaarrq9Rt4TPig%3D%3D)
---
| | The DVD gives you a seat at the table in a seminar-style class like those here on campus, and you'll read from the same book the students are in the course. In addition to the topics I've already mentioned, the course focuses on subjects including:
* Aristotle's _Politics_ and the Nature of Man
* Deliberation and Choice
* Practical Judgment
* Contemplation and Action

Just consider what Rebecca, a free online course student, recently said: _" I have learned [through the Aristotle course] that every choice we make etches into our soul."_ Make a good choice, and watch a special preview video of the course. Then reserve your DVD and book today using this secure link: [**_https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/aristotle-dvd-book-offer_**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1b4309e1b1ec44cfb394caf3802f7873&_e=3gaoah_9tRAdtnbBuQUM40M5xmpmd8sMyWIZg6FqbZ17RUHNh3IIybgLa5rSb0jCckXJ4-xvrpJMl350amfXVdu9vumZ2UNf4T1x_bpv_vN93nz7LOnBu3By-DAiMAmXncv4ZmVF871kl-W1SDXg79a3CCnipRpMwWAri4mNWYIRfeHNgIjdVOWdb2LXg9aKqGLDwy_lGaf8iWFdBeBSfzZxQWrZZTHVBnP_pQ0UrO3pqIDzfbAwOZTZvC5BvifPRLcwHrXzTVfHYO_ruNQU-XZmy4zHBdcnR3IvWtmsN2J5Refr9GpS1iesTjssJbra592gaO2LEvCbbvk4RcLtOL5UX9NfL6Lty9BWYsucqeoIP5q_E-Jn48wIv1IAP3VsBU0aLFqqX6-nCrhJJHg8yw%3D%3D) After watching the preview, if you're struggling with a thorny question, I hope you'll join Rebecca and many others by reserving your DVD of [**" Introduction to Aristotle's _Ethics_ "**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1b4309e1b1ec44cfb394caf3802f7873&_e=3gaoah_9tRAdtnbBuQUM40M5xmpmd8sMyWIZg6FqbZ17RUHNh3IIybgLa5rSb0jCckXJ4-xvrpJMl350amfXVdu9vumZ2UNf4T1x_bpv_vN93nz7LOnBu3By-DAiMAmXncv4ZmVF871kl-W1SDXg79a3CCnipRpMwWAri4mNWYIRfeHNgIjdVOWdb2LXg9aKqGLDwy_lGaf8iWFdBeBSfzZxQWrZZTHVBnP_pQ0UrO3CKiTBClV4cQGWhLtEWMUnJO_iPOd-Rwr9XGJCcZls1vPAlGrsoSIIDs1VTCzBztns4MsqIZTYDW0zKh8b6WiZglQqLtK6wA9j_xId2o9s-R2DCP42GavboryWAU5xkZZZ_9SuTnb1smWQ7Ki-Lz1fcFXbbkgTkblLa7c7tsF8pw%3D%3D)**** along with its companion book __ today _._ Quantities of the DVD and book are limited, so don't wait too long to decide. ---
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=b74caaf1cad64d7796eb26c2fa2929ce&_e=FetGa1QHVfMIM5RzpcJ0hvqfYaaD3BtQlWUHLJbsrTvAXaN8Yzo7g7Eq78t1bcEHWcOCdIz4ExPEHAwn9shKU12qJJIkji4qZmJGWf-nNtkv9UKFMFU7hiYFSq0u_x_kC5H-uLFFcpPOAGBf-KBdbcVOCQSGTpM9dNPDYYgmwq1VBARgvjsiVvbrvMIUThku5RYpCcsTarWy1cxgICsSeEddQZFdXgwLboRGOYoKyHwdzm-7X9bpPCctrTYDh9zgQyClH-G-HXeR7cjqIZ-mPKjYlGMTZoKUNkYS0QWUC4TapV1PgI2iDI2LUBM4v28tjhYXEXXMGiaHxQydx9Wcrah5w-ph47jqsddj2pQ6AJRXS__YR4R00ATNMpDNlLiO)

I was inspired to serve because America gave me everything. **My family escaped Communist Vietnam to the United States after the fall of Saigon. **
---
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=b74caaf1cad64d7796eb26c2fa2929ce&_e=FetGa1QHVfMIM5RzpcJ0hvqfYaaD3BtQlWUHLJbsrTvAXaN8Yzo7g7Eq78t1bcEHWcOCdIz4ExPEHAwn9shKU12qJJIkji4qZmJGWf-nNtkv9UKFMFU7hiYFSq0u_x_kC5H-uLFFcpPOAGBf-KBdbcVOCQSGTpM9dNPDYYgmwq1VBARgvjsiVvbrvMIUThku5RYpCcsTarWy1cxgICsSeEddQZFdXgwLboRGOYoKyHxiWOUs59-xWcalmCzjFgn32l6OGN50XpXxd-EnIqv0K-P0W5g2GlPABwhuRyCkci2dT30oaFJMeVBCejWqsuiCl_xBYxuBMRPszk5P0f3sb-1_zgqOqoLGEP-ATavWCaW0Kfj97xGiI_okhGPyqZ7K)
---
_If it wasn't for America, I probably wouldn't be alive today._

**I answered the call to duty when I was appointed to the Naval Academy as a young man. Now, I'm answering the call of duty to Americans once again._But my new mission is a little different._**
---
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=b74caaf1cad64d7796eb26c2fa2929ce&_e=FetGa1QHVfMIM5RzpcJ0hvqfYaaD3BtQlWUHLJbsrTvAXaN8Yzo7g7Eq78t1bcEHWcOCdIz4ExPEHAwn9shKU12qJJIkji4qZmJGWf-nNtkv9UKFMFU7hiYFSq0u_x_kC5H-uLFFcpPOAGBf-KBdbcVOCQSGTpM9dNPDYYgmwq1VBARgvjsiVvbrvMIUThku5RYpCcsTarWy1cxgICsSeEddQZFdXgwLboRGOYoKyHx1CUbycmASXYgxQPFKmLxzqx1doq7EMT55HEh1XicqMn343dZeuUow3iJasYsca_kDyf54RRdmVsO1-Y0W7RqR8PK0Rbl7WZQA4hE9F8V55HPKdyZJ4IqKhn25IHYKvYNP_bbMfx_jsP9zE8XDlnhL)

clean_body: Here's my story| | | Fellow Patriot, My name is Hung Cao. I am a retired Navy Captain who served for 25 years in Special Operations. I served on the front lines defusing bombs for our SEAL teams and Special Forces; I also conducted some of the most dangerous deep dives in the military. I was inspired to serve because America gave me everything. My family escaped Communist Vietnam to the United States after the fall of Saigon. If it wasn't for America, I probably wouldn't be alive today. I answered the call to duty when I was appointed to the Naval Academy as a young man. Now, I'm answering the call of duty to Americans once again.But my new mission is a little different. I'm now the OFFICIAL GOP nominee running for the U.S. Senate in Virginia because our voters believe our country needs true conservative leaders who put service over self. I put my life on the line for our American values and freedom because I know that America is worth defending. But today, career politicians like Tim “Hillary” Kaine are eroding the very liberties my fellow troops and I risked the ultimate sacrifice for. They've lost sight of what matters and are more interested in playing political games than serving the people they're supposed to represent. Now, I'm stepping up because we need a change. I fought for this country once, taking on terrorists face to face - I'm certainly not afraid to take on establishment politicians. We need strong leaders who will put the hardworking American people before special interests and the Clinton family insiders. I've made a commitment to our country before, and now, I'm ready to make a new one as a U.S. Senator. I'm not done with my mission for America, and I need your help to finish it. I'm asking humbly: Answer this call to duty with me and let's get America back on track. This eBook is part of the Human Prosperity Project, which offers scholarly analyses of various economic systems and their impacts on prosperity and well-being.

This eBook provides a balanced perspective on why capitalism might be the more humane and effective choice in a time of growing traction for socialist ideas.

subject: Thank you, President Biden
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tina Smith for Minnesota
body:
|
#
Team, President Biden announced yesterday that he is stepping aside from the presidential ticket. I am incredibly grateful for President Biden’s leadership and service to our country. For over 50 years, he has modeled what public service should look like: a deep commitment to making a difference for everyone, no matter who they are or where they live. He restored the soul of our nation at a time when we needed it most. He rehabilitated our relationship with foreign nations. And he defended our democracy in the moments when we needed it most, after the January 6 insurrection at the U.S. Capitol. President Biden and Vice President Harris have accomplished an extraordinary amount — signing into law the _Bipartisan Infrastructure Law_ , the _CHIPS and Science Act_ , and the _Inflation Reduction Act_. The impacts of these laws are far-reaching and will make a difference for generations to come. It has been the honor of a lifetime to serve alongside our Commander-in-Chief, my friend, President Joe Biden — one of the finest public servants we will ever know. And I am honored to have his support and endorsement.
| | | I am running to be President of the United States.

**It has been the honor of a lifetime to serve alongside our Commander-in-Chief, my friend, President Joe Biden — one of the finest public servants we will ever know. And I am honored to have his support and endorsement.**

And I am eager to run on the record of what Joe and I have accomplished together. We built our country back after our predecessor left it in shambles -- making historic progress in reducing prescription drug costs, upgrading our nation's infrastructure, fighting climate change, and more. We are stronger today because we took action -- together -- to invest in America's future.

I am excited to continue to work toward our vision for a better future for all. But we also need to expand Democrats' majority in the Senate to continue to deliver progress for the American people. name: Tony Evers
subject: Thank you, President Biden
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tony for Wisconsin
body:
President Biden has been an extraordinary president, one of—if not the most-well-accomplished presidents of my lifetime. | Derek,

President Biden has been an extraordinary president, one of—if not the most-well-accomplished presidents of my lifetime. He is a leader who's always chosen unity over division, people over politics, selflessness over selfishness, and decency and respect over cruelty and retribution, and that's as evident today as it has been throughout each day of his decades of public service. Thank you, President Biden.

With 106 days until the election, the stakes are high, and I'm excited to endorse Vice President Harris as our next nominee for President of the United States.

[Wisconsin needs to get work. Can I count on you to rush a donation to our rapid response fund to help stand with Kamala Harris? This election will likely come down to Wisconsin, and closing our $31,392 budget gap is critical to make sure we have the resources to fight back against extreme Republican attacks!](https://go.tonyevers.com/go/2262?amount=10&refcode=EM_NBI_TE_20240722_FR_HarrisFR_0_3MO_Evers_NA_NA_NA&t=5&akid=6815%2E1827488%2EKT1urg)

Vice President Kamala Harris is a tenacious leader who has vigorously defended our democracy, fought to protect the freedoms we hold dear, and worked tirelessly to do the right thing and deliver for us. She can beat Donald Trump, and I'm going to do everything I can between now and November 5th to help make sure she does.

The choice remains clear this November. Donald Trump wants to be a dictator on day one. He is a dangerous threat to our democracy and our country, and he will enact a radical, authoritarian agenda if he returns to the Oval Office.

[There is much work ahead of us, and Wisconsin Democrats and I will spend every moment of every day working to defeat Donald Trump. Can I count on you to join us?](https://go.tonyevers.com/go/2262?amount=10&refcode=EM_NBI_TE_20240722_FR_HarrisFR_0_3MO_Evers_NA_NA_NA&t=6&akid=6815%2E1827488%2EKT1urg)

Onward,

Tony

name: Matt Diemer
subject: We've got our work cut out for us
body:
| |
---
Peter, It's become pretty clear that Kamala Harris will become the Democratic nominee in August. And I stand with her. Vice President Harris has the opportunity to beat Donald Trump and become the first woman elected President of the United States. This is an exciting time to be a Democrat, and we should be pumped about November. Winning this November won't be easy. It's going to take everything we have. I'm ready to do everything possible to work with Kamala Harris and Democrats up and down the ballot to beat Donald Trump and the rest of the MAGA Republicans. body:

Friend,

President Biden has shown us what statesmanship is all about: commanding great power with grace, and giving it up with courage.

He’s handed the reins to the American most prepared to take them up: our historic Vice President. Kamala Harris has the energy, the vision, and the courage to unite our party and beat Donald Trump. The American people said that they wanted new nominees on both sides of the aisle, but only the Democratic Party has delivered.

There are four months between now and the election, and that is plenty of time for Americans to see the dramatic contrast between Trump’s dark vision for a second term and the bright, optimistic, opportunity-filled future I know Kamala Harris will present.

Part of our bright future is building on the enormous legacy President Biden will leave. In deeply divided times, he passed major, bipartisan bills that will serve our country for a generation. For decades in the Senate, and through twelve remarkable years in the White House, he worked to bridge divides in our nation and serve the American people. That’s a legacy that we all, regardless of party, should appreciate.

Joe Biden also leaves a legacy that is deeply personal for many of us. He has been one of my greatest mentors in politics, as I know he was for many Democrats through the decades, and I feel fortunate to call him a friend. For years he has been a father of our party and a leader for America and the world.

President Biden is following in the footsteps of George Washington by passing the torch, and I know future generations will aspire to the record of service he has left for our country.

Regards,

Seth

name: Wes Moore
subject: Today I am announcing my endorsement of Kamala Harris
body:
Friend,

President Biden has an extraordinary legacy throughout his five decades of public service, particularly during his time in the White House. The people deserve a champion who will continue the progress of the Biden-Harris administration.

Today, I’m proud to announce my full endorsement of Vice President Kamala Harris for President.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20240722-1?refcode=em20240722-1&amount=20.24 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20240722-1?refcode=em20240722-1&amount=20.24]

Will you make a split donation of $20.24 between my and Kamala’s campaigns to celebrate the launch of her campaign? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20240722-1?refcode=em20240722-1&amount=20.24]

Contribute $20.24 » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20240722-1?refcode=em20240722-1&amount=20.24]

My endorsement today goes far beyond politics. The morning that the Francis Scott Key Bridge collapsed, one of the first calls I received was from Vice President Harris. She made clear that the entire nation stood with Maryland as we confronted one of the worst tragedies in the history of our state. In that moment, she demonstrated not just her powers of leadership, but also her powers of empathy. It’s something Dawn and I have witnessed first-hand, as we’ve gotten to know the Vice President and her extraordinary family. She has the experience, record, vision, and wisdom to unify the country.

She has the unique ability to energize the Democratic Party base and we must rally around her in this historic moment so she can become the next President of the United States.

America is at a crossroads: Do we choose to move forward and building on the progress of record job creation and decreases in violent crime nationwide, or do we choose to go backward, toward divisive rhetoric and attacks on women’s reproductive health and other fundamental freedoms?

Kamala Harris will move us forward , toward a brighter future for all. She is the fighter we need at this moment to realize the full promise of our nation. Please, friend, make a split contribution of $20.24 or more today to Vice President Harris and my campaign today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20240722-1?refcode=em20240722-1&amount=20.24]

Contribute $20.24 » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20240722-1?refcode=em20240722-1&amount=20.24]

Elevate,

Wes

---
| | **For Immediate Release:** July 22, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**Dave Min Endorses Kamala Harris For President**
**IRVINE, CA** —Dave Min made this statement following about Vice President Kamala Harris’s candidacy:

**“The 2024 presidential election may be the most important election of our lifetimes. I know Kamala Harris can win this election and be a strong leader for our country. She is not only a trailblazer who is the first woman and Asian American in the White House, she has been a leader on protecting women’s reproductive rights, gun safety, and climate rescue, issues I care deeply about. As a prosecutor, she stood up for the rule of law and law enforcement and cracked down on Wall Street fraud—a stark contrast to lawbreaking felons like Donald Trump and my opponent Scott Baugh who have spent their careers abusing the public trust for their own enrichment. I am proud to support Vice President Harris and look forward to working with her next year when I am elected to Congress.”** ### _California’s 47th is an open_[ _DCCC Red To Blue_](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=a34d5c0add&e=7017cc100e) _Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Democratic Representative Katie Porter is not running for re-election. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this_[ _“toss up”_](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=dc2e36ceb8&e=7017cc100e) _district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country._

Yes, the RNC was scary, and we need real resistance with Jill

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=rnc_real_resistance&n=1)

Peter, The gaudy spectacle of the Republican National Convention revealed the true reactionary face of their political schemes and plans. Trump’s draconian vision, cloaked under the Orwellian promise to “Make America Great Once Again” includes:
* Demonizing and scapegoating hard working immigrants, vowing to shut the border and finish building the wall
* Rolling back reproductive rights
* Decreasing the already paltry taxes paid by big corporations
* Bullying sovereign nations into submission to U.S. military dominance
* Rolling back hard fought for gains by the 2SLGBTQIA+ community, and
* Catapulting us closer to the brink of climate catastrophe with his demand that we “Drill, baby, drill” our children’s futures away

Contrast that to Jill’s humanistic vision for the people:
* Economic equity that includes a $25 an hour minimum wage
* Healthcare and housing as human rights
* Abolish ICE, grant amnesty to undocumented people, create an expedited path to citizenship
* Stopping military aggression around the world for a lasting peace
* Declaring a climate emergency on day one and implementing a real Green New Deal to reverse the course of climate disaster we’re heading towards.
* Full equal rights for women and the 2SLGBTQIA+ community including the right to make autonomous decisions about their own bodies, free of government interference

The anti-Democratic Party claims that they’re all that stand between the Republican Party’s dark, authoritarian plans for our nation and yet they have enabled and capitulated to them at every turn for over a generation, moving further and further to the right to keep up with them. The Republican National Convention makes clear that the dirty duopoly isn’t the answer. Only Jill and the Green Party stand firm in resistance to Trump and the Republicans. Jill is the candidate whose heart is for the people and who will fight for the policies that the American people want and the world needs at this critical moment. As President, Jill will give the people a government that _cares_ again! Can you donate today to make sure that Jill is a choice for voters all over the nation and that her empowering vision is able to reach masses of people?

They sought to vilify and demonize us – to RUIN us personally, professionally, and financially. They’re even seeking toJAIL us as completely innocent men! The HOPE that I felt when seeing President Trump take the stage in 2016, is the very same hope I still feel today despite all the witch hunts and phony charges that Crooked Joe and his Deep State goons have brought against President Trump and me. Why? Because just like President Trump, generous patriots like YOU have shown me what it will take to defeat Crooked Joe and the Left’s Third-World regime. We NEVER,EVER SURRENDER to it! So, to show these left-wing crooks that good and honest Americans like YOU will not stand by as they destroy the life of an INNOCENT man all for defending our 45th and future 47th President, I’m humbly asking for your support to help raise $231,375.70 (the exact booking number of my forced MUGSHOT!) to keep up the fight for my freedom and justice during this dark chapter. ~~ {BOOKING # 2313757} ~~ ~~ ~ ~ ~~ Thank you and God bless you, ~~ Rudy Giuliani Rudy Giuliani Freedom Fund Paid for by Rudy Giuliani Freedom Fund Legal Defense Trust Restore Our Nation PO Box 1177 Fort Collins, CO 80522 | ~~_

subject: There has never been a more critical moment to invest in Missouri’s U.S. Senate race
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
#
Peter — There has never been a better or more critical moment to invest in Missouri’s U.S. Senate race. Here are three quick reasons why:
1. **Josh Hawley has never been more vulnerable.** Hawley won his last race with only 51% of the vote — and now, after spending six whole years attacking reproductive rights and openly declaring a “Christian nationalist” crusade in Washington, he’s become the least popular GOP U.S. Senator up for re-election this year.
2. **Our grassroots campaign has a real path to victory.** We’ve outraised Hawley at nearly every fundraising deadline, we’ve earned historic support from Missouri’s election-winning labor movement, and we’ve even got an initiative to end our state’s total abortion ban on the ballot. If we can keep aggressively communicating Hawley’s record of extremism to voters, we can elect Lucas Kunce this November.

We need strong leaders who will put the hardworking American people before special interests and the Clinton family insiders. I've made a commitment to our country before, and now, I'm ready to make a new one as a U.S. Senator. I'm not done with my mission for America, and I need your help to finish it. No doubt, this is an unprecedented situation. And that means we need to raise unprecedented resources to ensure we have what it takes to meet the unique needs of this moment and support Vice President Harris’ campaign for president. | **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader.

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

Can I explain something, folks?
I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents.
**In fact, I’m very proud to be the U.S. Senate’s only working dirt farmer.**
Every spring, I spend a lot of weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive.
I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand.
The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy—but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded.
**And rather than spend my days hobnobbing with special interests, I rely on hard-working folks like you to power everything we do.**

# Erin Farris-Olsen for Clerk of the Montana Supreme Court 2024,

You’ve probably read some sort of “breaking news” coming out about the ongoing Presidential Election - I know I have.
Americans across the country are experiencing an election that is driving news cycle after news cycle, and I’m sure many of us are tired at this point, no matter who we’re voting for.
[**To that end, I need your help more than ever.**](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=8ddf6bfdbb&e=5e62e9066d)
---
[](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=cf0baf101d&e=5e62e9066d)
| **The Presidential Election isn’t the only one going on right now, and it’s far from the only one that will have implications for the future of thousands if not hundreds of thousands of people.**
We’re fighting for Montanans to have a Clerk that betters the Court and shapes our everyday lives, helping to maintain the impartiality and objectivity of our Supreme Court, and protecting the integrity of the Judiciary for all Montanans. That fight starts with you.
---
[SUPPORT TODAY!](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=9495cf9d80&e=5e62e9066d)
| That fight isn’t cheap. [**I need your donation today if I am going to win this race and be a Clerk that Montanans can rely on to be impartial, effective, and just.**](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=6e555bb276&e=5e62e9066d)
When we come together for a just cause, nothing can stop us. Thank you in advance for your support.
Regards,
**Erin**

By now you've know doubt seen the news that President Biden has decided to suspend his re-election campaign and endorse Vice President Kamala Harris.

Friends -
By now you've no doubt seen the news that President Biden has decided to suspend his re-election campaign and endorse Vice President Kamala Harris.
Joe Biden has been an extraordinary, history-making president. He will go down in history as one of the most impactful and selfless presidents.
Kamala Harris?
She's tough, fearless, and tenacious.
With our democracy at stake and our future on the line, no one is better to prosecute the case against Donald Trump's dark vision and guide our country in a healthier direction than her.
I intend to spend the next several months working to defeat Donald Trump and elect Democrats everywhere. I have already visited a number of states campaigning for Joe Biden and many other Democrats and state parties. That work won't stop.
But a President Harris also needs a Democratic Senate. So with that in mind, I am asking:

Kamala Harris is no stranger to smashing glass ceilings. In the leadup to becoming Vice President, she was the **first** Black woman in California to be elected district attorney, the **first** woman to be California’s Attorney General, and then the **first** woman of color to represent California in the Senate.

Throughout her time in these roles, she has protected women from dangerous situations, uplifted democracy, passed historic gun-control legislation, and more. As President, we know she will defend and protect our country with dignity and strength while safeguarding the important progress we have made as a nation.

As we celebrate the possibilities and opportunities of this moment, we want to make something very clear: **It's only a matter of time before the racism, sexism, and vitriol make this campaign hell for Harris and those around her. We’re so excited about this moment in our nation’s history but understand that she will need our support to ensure voters know what’s at stake in this election. = = The August 2024 cover of Time Magazine If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will be processed immediately and automatically split between Her Bold Move and Kamala Harris: | | = | | = | = | | = | = | | = Kamala Harris is no stranger to smashing glass ceilings. In the leadup to becoming Vice President, she was the first Black woman in California to be elected district attorney, the first woman to be California’s Attorney General, and then the first woman of color to represent California in the Senate. Throughout her time in these roles, she has protected women from dangerous situations, uplifted democracy, passed historic gun-control legislation, and more. As President, we know she will defend and protect our country with dignity and strength while safeguarding the important progress we have made as a nation. As we celebrate the possibilities and opportunities of this moment, we want to make something very clear: It's only a matter of time before the racism, sexism, and vitriol make this campaign hell for Harris and those around her. We need to get ahead of these attacks by showing our support today. = To quote President Biden, “It’s time to come together and beat Trump.” Together, Her Bold Move | | Her Bold Move believes that ambitious women will transform our country. This endorsement vote is open from now until 2:00pm ET on Tuesday, July 23rd. | | | Dear Peter: After weeks of speculation, President Biden announced yesterday that he was withdrawing from the 2024 race for President, and endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris to be the Democratic nominee in November. Over the last 24 hours, Harris has already won strong endorsements from WFP champions in Congress, including Elizabeth Warren, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Jamaal Bowman, Cori Bush, Summer Lee, Ilhan Omar, Greg Casar, Delia Ramirez, and more. Meanwhile, others whose names had been floated as potential candidates have declined to run and joined in endorsing her. Now, it’s our turn to make a decision. For months, you’ve told us in our member surveys that your top priority is to defeat MAGA and Trump. **We know that there is still a strong anti-MAGA majority in this country. We know that we can defeat them — because we’ve done it before. And we know just how high the stakes are for our communities.** In an election season like no other, and with only 105 days left to reach voters, we can’t afford to wait on the sidelines any longer. ****[**Today, we're asking Working Families Party members to help us make the next decision in our process: Should the Working Families Party endorse Kamala Harris for President in order to get started right away on building the biggest possible movement to defeat Donald Trump in November? It means we will double down on our plans to reach and turn out voters in critical swing states and demographic groups, just like we did in 2020 when we endorsed the Biden-Harris ticket and drove massive turnout in states like Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, and Georgia that were key to defeating Trump in the Electoral College. An endorsement of VP Harris _wouldn’t_ mean we’ll never disagree with her, or slow down for a second in fighting for our transformative vision, from guaranteeing healthcare for all to a ceasefire in Gaza.
It _would_ mean going all-out to build a popular front against MAGA in November that includes both _blocking_ authoritarian Republicans from controlling the government and _building_ a multi-racial working class movement by electing WFP champions to Congress, to state houses and all the way down the ballot. **This is not a drill. We know what Trump and MAGA Republicans are planning to do to our communities if they win in November. That’s because they are telling us.** They plan to use federal forces to round up and detain millions in camps, then deport them. To decimate the civil service and replace nonpolitical government employees with MAGA loyalists. To take revenge against their opponents by directing federal prosecutions against their critics. To pardon insurrectionists and reward their billionaire backers with tax cuts. To ban abortion nationwide, let our climate burn, and make working people pay more for everything. All with a compliant, corrupt Supreme Court majority that now says a president cannot be prosecuted for any of it. Our movement has proven that we can deliver real wins for the working class that improve people’s lives. We have a record to run on, and a powerful vision that can inspire voters across the country. clean_body: This endorsement vote is open from now until 2:00pm ET on Tuesday, July 23rd. | | | Dear Peter: After weeks of speculation, President Biden announced yesterday that he was withdrawing from the 2024 race for President, and endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris to be the Democratic nominee in November. Over the last 24 hours, Harris has already won strong endorsements from WFP champions in Congress, including Elizabeth Warren, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Jamaal Bowman, Cori Bush, Summer Lee, Ilhan Omar, Greg Casar, Delia Ramirez, and more. Meanwhile, others whose names had been floated as potential candidates have declined to run and joined in endorsing her. Now, it’s our turn to make a decision. For months, you’ve told us in our member surveys that your top priority is to defeat MAGA and Trump. We know that there is still a strong anti-MAGA majority in this country. We know that we can defeat them — because we’ve done it before. And we know just how high the stakes are for our communities. In an election season like no other, and with only 105 days left to reach voters, we can’t afford to wait on the sidelines any longer. ** If we endorse Kamala Harris for President, that means we will go all out to elect her and defeat Donald Trump — starting right now. It means we will double down on our plans to reach and turn out voters in critical swing states and demographic groups, just like we did in 2020 when we endorsed the Biden-Harris ticket and drove massive turnout in states like Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, and Georgia that were key to defeating Trump in the Electoral College. An endorsement of VP Harris wouldn’t mean we’ll never disagree with her, or slow down for a second in fighting for our transformative vision, from guaranteeing healthcare for all to a ceasefire in Gaza. It would mean going all-out to build a popular front against MAGA in November that includes both blocking authoritarian Republicans from controlling the government and building a multi-racial working class movement by electing WFP champions to Congress, to state houses and all the way down the ballot. This is not a drill. We know what Trump and MAGA Republicans are planning to do to our communities if they win in November. That’s because they are telling us. They plan to use federal forces to round up and detain millions in camps, then deport them. To decimate the civil service and replace nonpolitical government employees with MAGA loyalists. To take revenge against their opponents by directing federal prosecutions against their critics. To pardon insurrectionists and reward their billionaire backers with tax cuts. To ban abortion nationwide, let our climate burn, and make working people pay more for everything. All with a compliant, corrupt Supreme Court majority that now says a president cannot be prosecuted for any of it. Our movement has proven that we can deliver real wins for the working class that improve people’s lives. We have a record to run on, and a powerful vision that can inspire voters across the country. And we want to get started now communicating to voters on the doors, on the phones, in our communities, via texting, postcards, and online. Given the stakes, should the Working Families Party throw down to defeat Trump once and for all? That's the question we are asking right now. And we need to know where you stand: When you cast your vote, we also hope you’ll share your reason for your vote. We will read every response, and may share selected reasons submitted by WFP members (with your permission) with media and other members. This endorsement vote is open from now until 2:00pm ET on Tuesday, July 23rd. Here's how it will work: The Working Families National Committee — which is made of delegates representing WFP state chapters as well as national progressive organizations, unions and movement leaders — will comprise 50% of the total vote share. WFP members will also receive 50% of the total vote share. (A WFP member is anyone who is currently signed up to WFP's email or text list as of 7/21/24). Please take a moment to cast your vote now: In solidarity, Maurice Mitchell National Director Working Families Party Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. NOTE: This email was intended for dpwillis67@gmail.com and reflects our records for this email address only. If you were forwarded this message, please be aware that only WFP members subscribed to the Working Families Party’s email or text list as of July 21, 2024 are eligible to vote. Individuals may only vote once and ballots are not transferable. For more on how the vote will work, The Working Families Party is the party of the multiracial working class, fighting for a nation that cares for all of us. Wanna learn more? And if you need to update your contact information, Other political groups have corporate donors. body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1680%2E135344%2ELhZaRf)

Friend --
As you certainly know by now, President Biden made a patriotic — and no doubt, difficult — decision to step aside and end his presidential campaign.
And if your inbox is anything like ours, that has led to a flood of emails asking for your support, including from our campaign.
And in historic moments like this one, we know that few people are wishing for MORE emails asking for money, especially when some of those emails have no clear connection to the critical task of keeping Democrats in control of the White House.
And that is why we want to explain how our race fits into all of this.
In other words: why Elissa and why now? And why all these emails?
Because the reality is there is no winning the White House or holding on to the Senate without Michigan.
Because Elissa has a track record of “losing better” in redder areas and that benefits Democrats up and down the ticket.
Because we have been building a campaign operation to reach voters in all 11 of Michigan’s media markets and, despite the uncertainty of an unprecedented moment, we are full steam ahead.
Because for all the uncertainty this moment holds, we know that Republicans are likely seeing an uptick in their momentum as well -- which means this is not a moment we can let just go by for our campaign.
And more than anything, because the majority of individual contributions to this campaign come from emails like this one.
So yes, we have to email a little more. But only because it is absolutely critical we meet this moment, and that means having the resources to exceed energy on the Republican side and continue doing the hard work to keep Michigan blue.

Hi Friend,
Yesterday, President Biden officially withdrew from the 2024 Presidential race and endorsed Kamala Harris for President of the United States.
I want to extend my deepest gratitude to President Biden , for putting country over self; for passing the baton to VP Harris and, most importantly, for being a deeply empathetic leader who has transformed our nation for the better!
As the first ever South Asian American elected to Philadelphia City Council, I loudly and proudly endorse Kamala Harris for President of the United States . She is supremely qualified and battle tested . She will reclaim and strengthen our reproductive freedoms and crush Donald Trump and HIS Project 2025 . It is imperative that we all join together to win this November and support our country’s first South Asian and Black woman Democratic presidential nominee!
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/106735/images/NA%20Kamala.jpg]
President Biden has been a transformational leader and has accomplished more in the last four years than we have seen in decades. From defeating Trump in 2020, to guiding us through a global pandemic, to lowering prescription drug prices, to historic investments in infrastructure and against climate change, to gun safety legislation, to uniting our global allies, and so much more - I am deeply grateful for his decades of service and for his wisdom .
I am confident that, if we come together, we can unite our party, defeat Donald Trump, and win in November. I look forward with all of my heart to seeing the faces of women and girls across our nation as we watch Kamala Harris take the presidential oath of office next January.
I am committed to working as hard as possible over the next few months to ensure Democratic victories up and down the ballot. We know that the future of our country will be decided in Pennsylvania and it’s up to each of us to stop Donald Trump once and for all !
To victory!
Councilmember Nina Ahmad

Folks, By now, you’ve probably seen the news that President Biden has withdrawn from the 2024 presidential election... **And Republicans are panicking.** _Donald Trump went on a late-night (and early morning today) Truth Social tirade..._ _The Republican National Committee is rewriting its entire playbook to elect Donald Trump in November..._ _And Speaker Mike Johnson already announced the GOP _is ready and willing to file lawsuits over removing President Biden as the nominee...__ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89356504/487027851/-1381128232?refcode=em-7.22.24-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTkxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2M2E4ZTMwMC02NTQ4LWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hXuutX3oKiD2RhQS_TA2t29BaMcLQO8Z4OoCfV7NOy4=) These legal challenges shouldn’t shock us though, folks. In 2020, Trump and his surrogates filed 62 lawsuits contesting election processes, vote counting, and the vote certification process in nine states. Nearly all of these were dismissed or dropped. And last election, his MAGA allies running for Secretary of State followed suit: **Kirstina Karamo** filed lawsuits before her double digit loss in Michigan.**Jim Marchant** tried to overturn his loss in Nevada. **Mark Finchem** is still pushing lawsuits to overturn his loss in Arizona. Winning elections at the ballot box is our first priority. But we need to be ready for MAGA attempts in the courtroom, where they will likely challenge the integrity of the electoral process every chance they get. Peter,
The stakes of the presidential race here in Pennsylvania are too high to not meet this moment.
Vice President Harris has been leading the fight for women’s rights, workers’ rights, and voting rights, and as a former prosecutor, she will draw a clear contrast between herself and former President Trump.
And like in 2016 and 2020, the stakes of the presidential race and the Senate majority could all come down to Pennsylvania in 2024.
**[Will you help us meet this moment in Pennsylvania and split a donation between my campaign and Kamala Harris?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240722-3?refcode=em20240722-3&refcode2=3632_552475_-czxEy&akid=3632%2E552475%2E-czxEy)**

But right now, the Republican party has a huge fundraising advantage, and we need to do everything we can to catch up.
**[Help us show the strength of this campaign by splitting any amount right now between my campaign and Kamala Harris.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240722-3?refcode=em20240722-3&refcode2=3632_552475_-czxEy&akid=3632%2E552475%2E-czxEy)**

Bob Casey

Right now, we join Americans across the country in thanking President Joe Biden for his service to our nation. Attorney General Holder issued the following statement: _"We are lucky to have had Joe Biden for so many years. I’ve known and worked with him for over two decades. He is an incredible man. His principled, effective leadership and love for our country has made our nation better in a great many ways._ _His decision to put country over candidacy is emblematic of the person I know him to be. Walking away from power is an unusual and difficult thing to do. Too many can’t do it. Washington did. Johnson did._ _Yesterday, Joe Biden demonstrated strength, self confidence and love for America. I thank him for all that he has done and look forward to seeing him on the campaign trail in the next four months and to see what more he will accomplish in the years to come. We love you Joe."

– A.G. Eric H. Holder, Jr._ We’re energized for the work ahead between now and Election Day. While there’s plenty to do in the days and weeks ahead, let’s all take a minute to recognize the President’s historic, patriotic decision. [**Add your name today to join us and A.G. Holder in thanking

clean_body: We thank President Joe Biden for his service to our nation | Right now, we join Americans across the country in thanking President Joe Biden for his service to our nation. Attorney General Holder issued the following statement: "We are lucky to have had Joe Biden for so many years. I’ve known and worked with him for over two decades. He is an incredible man. His principled, effective leadership and love for our country has made our nation better in a great many ways. His decision to put country over candidacy is emblematic of the person I know him to be. Walking away from power is an unusual and difficult thing to do. Too many can’t do it. Washington did. Johnson did. Yesterday, Joe Biden demonstrated strength, self confidence and love for America. I thank him for all that he has done and look forward to seeing him on the campaign trail in the next four months and to see what more he will accomplish in the years to come. We love you Joe." – A.G. Eric H. Holder, Jr. We’re energized for the work ahead between now and Election Day. While there’s plenty to do in the days and weeks ahead, let’s all take a minute to recognize the President’s historic, patriotic decision. body:
It’s been a crazy 10 days. Here’s an update from the campaign trail. | | | | |
---
| It’s been a crazy 10 days. Here’s an update from the campaign trail.
**Republican National Convention in Milwaukee** It was an honor to host the Republican National Convention in Wisconsin last week. It was a great opportunity to showcase our state to the rest of the country.
I was happy to see Milwaukee and the state of Wisconsin get the national recognition it deserves!
---
| I’ve always said there’s no better place than Wisconsin in the summer. And now the rest of the country understands why!
Thank you to all of the volunteers who made last week successful and enjoyable for everyone!
---
| **Upcoming August Ballot Referendums** Wisconsin’s primary election is coming up. On August 13, I encourage you to head to the polls and vote in your partisan primary.

They say: Democratic women, especially women of color, have always been the backbone of our party. For decades, we have helped to win majorities and drive progress.
We have the talent, experience, and tenacity to lead. It's time to break more glass ceilings and dismantle the outdated political structures that hold us back.

subject: re: President Biden's big announcement

body:
our path forward
| | |
---
Team Rosen,

President Joe Biden just announced that he is no longer seeking reelection.
**This is an unprecedented moment in an election cycle – and it will have profound effects for our country and on the Senate race here in Nevada. **What we do next is going to determine who wins the White House and the Senate in November, plain and simple.
[**(This is a longer message, but if you are already with me, can you make a $5 donation to my campaign _right now_ so we can protect our Democratic Senate majority? I wouldn’t ask if it wasn’t critically important.)**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89361841/487046277/1399925512?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk4230-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4OGZhMGU3Yi02ZjQ4LWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ALOeIvDzLdoYdxhPgmDXRwIdxWTDgCGjLzfSyWUmJho=)
**I’m going to be straight with you: Republicans want us to be divided.** In the days and weeks following President Biden’s announcement, they will try to catch us off guard so they can flood battleground states like Nevada with millions of dollars before we have a second to catch our breath and respond.
**_We absolutely cannot let that happen._**
Another four years of Trump in the White House with a Republican Senate majority would be catastrophic to everything we believe in and fight for. Defending our Senate majority is the ONLY way we can safeguard our most fundamental rights and freedoms – no matter what happens at the top of the ticket.
Political experts predict that Nevada will determine control of the Senate AND the White House, which means everything from abortion rights to our very democracy is on the line in the Silver State.** ****_The Cook Political Report_ recently downgraded Nevada from “Toss-Up” to “Lean R,” so we have our work cut out for us. **

Hi friend,
Nearly four years ago, President Biden put an end to Donald Trump’s chaos. He put us on a path toward progress, began to turn the page on Ronald Reagan’s failed trickle-down economics, and put working American families at the center of his agenda.

| **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader.

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

Hi Peter,
Yesterday, President Biden decided to end his reelection campaign and focus on finishing out his term.
**We want to express our sincere gratitude to President Biden for his historic achievements, including a strong commitment to supporting care workers and families.**
Under the Biden-Harris administration, April was declared **Care Workers Recognition Month** — recognizing the essential work that care workers do.
We’ve seen unprecedented progress for care infrastructure and the care economy, including **executive actions** to **improve care** and **support family caregivers and care workers.**
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89363086/487050712/307508371?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiM2RjMmEwYi03MzQ4LWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ealreyecDdjxw1CiA6ejb2Ulg7UMWGcKAb6G_PRs0eI=&emci=0878c19d-6e48-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=b3dc2a0b-7348-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=864787)

From ensuring higher wages for care workers, to making child care more affordable, to enhancing care quality for our loved ones, the Biden‐Harris administration has **demonstrated that they will always prioritize care.**
Now, we look ahead to this November, as the Republican ticket has _no plan to invest in care work._
**We can’t afford for Donald Trump to be reelected and prioritize the ultra‐rich over working families.**

Hi Peter, Yesterday, President Biden decided to end his reelection campaign and focus on finishing out his term. We want to express our sincere gratitude to President Biden for his historic achievements, including a strong commitment to supporting care workers and families. Under the Biden-Harris administration, April was declared Care Workers Recognition Month — recognizing the essential work that care workers do. We’ve seen unprecedented progress for care infrastructure and the care economy, including executive actions to improve care and support family caregivers and care workers. From ensuring higher wages for care workers, to making child care more affordable, to enhancing care quality for our loved ones, the Biden‐Harris administration has demonstrated that they will always prioritize care. Now, we look ahead to this November, as the Republican ticket has no plan to invest in care work. We can’t afford for Donald Trump to be reelected and prioritize the ultra‐rich over working families. In solidarity, Care in Action

Fellow American,

**Meeting patriots from across the country in Milwaukee who are dedicated to Saving America was such a blessing. **

Monday started off with the announcement we've all been waiting for... Trump's next Vice President! I'm thrilled at his choice; Senator Vance is a Patriot and Leader in the America First Movement, and _there is no one better to represent the American Dream_. JD represents the next generation of Conservatives and truly embodies the meaning of MAGA. He is the perfect match to run alongside President Trump and lead us to victory this November.

[](http://links.nicolemalliotakis.com/u/click?_t=759a85d1cba743719e64e2569e23c9b8&_m=304a442fb72a4b608257519881322c01&_e=0JTSGyek4yBYQm0ory7qXYX2agwn12u6dRkgT1_GXaUIBJPmNAMOYUlhLdamsq8QfzmuK_UI2wJjZyiYEzC5oiypHQ1-3ZO3Pb8wV7rx8FDRkV29JFbt0rhjPkV1ry3sIO1JYgcv6pjc0T7zDF_AcAIql6a7tm1w21OgPFZ7oNwM5YTLqMIXmHBHRpPtXEGX3aEjp3SjqD_Vnzq7GZCVVqI4fMFTQskOzJjJpaZ0eoYPWzr16CMEQrz7qvlFAc2dEjTZa_P9HHDeZCyAMXu88Pj-ogEcW3tsQH1P_5Qm3vLgyvmARPWB86WbkX1XiFHr)
On the same night, I was honored to be mentioned by Teamster President Sean M. O'Brien in his speech. As the daughter of a long-time union member, I'm proud to stand with Teamsters and the hardworking men and women of NYC and the USA!

On day two of the Convention, the focus was "Make America Safe Once Again." America and NYC have struggled under crime and the Biden Administration. Now is our chance to make a change for the better. President Trump is the courageous, defiant, and fearless leader America needs if we are to restore border security and economic prosperity, lower inflation and interest rates, and make energy and food affordable again.

**The America First Movement is gaining momentum. President Trump is gaining support from American unions, minorities, and young people - exactly what our party needs.**

I also had the honor of meeting Ambassador Geraldine Byrne Nason, the Ambassador of Ireland to the United States.

[](http://links.nicolemalliotakis.com/u/click?_t=759a85d1cba743719e64e2569e23c9b8&_m=304a442fb72a4b608257519881322c01&_e=0JTSGyek4yBYQm0ory7qXYX2agwn12u6dRkgT1_GXaUIBJPmNAMOYUlhLdamsq8QfzmuK_UI2wJjZyiYEzC5oiypHQ1-3ZO3Pb8wV7rx8FDRkV29JFbt0rhjPkV1ry3sIO1JYgcv6pjc0T7zDF_AcAIql6a7tm1w21OgPFZ7oNwIqPIioOtdr4I1koFGVhPcnCtCfVuF46Mz5CMjyzLW_Z9n2qLXvXFjuaIcOI8f6liROVU-jYIWB6585ISWVBKX9K6tEJYpho1-ZDm2Aqn7zuQKiujUPx9y9noFHR6JW50twothumVjwd7xfRbQfxkF)
On Wednesday, we focused on how to make "America Strong Once Again." New York Democrats continue to use billions of our hard-earned tax dollars to house illegal immigrants committing crimes in luxury hotels. _They keep giving free healthcare and services while New Yorkers struggle to get by_. Trump will undo Biden's policies and secure our borders again.

**This election will be decided on public safety, the economy, and National Security.**

On Wednesday night, I had the honor of watching the convention from President Trump's box.

[](http://links.nicolemalliotakis.com/u/click?_t=759a85d1cba743719e64e2569e23c9b8&_m=304a442fb72a4b608257519881322c01&_e=0JTSGyek4yBYQm0ory7qXYX2agwn12u6dRkgT1_GXaUIBJPmNAMOYUlhLdamsq8QfzmuK_UI2wJjZyiYEzC5oiypHQ1-3ZO3Pb8wV7rx8FDRkV29JFbt0rhjPkV1ry3sIO1JYgcv6pjc0T7zDF_AcAIql6a7tm1w21OgPFZ7oNwF4aURj0GQDv6R9lU4f79wtSd4NEaQ8tkJ3I0sDfpA5aLCoJvvUZB1DATW3cL0S86DYFGc3baxP9nT61qlUtIFuRfYh4bh8K_4LdxzcxsIspl02QRQRi1FaC-9k_6M8UlNqBmh6r2KdL_3tzr7rW2B)
_I 'm honored to stand by President Trump's side and help work to get America back on track_. The American people are desperate for change. These last four years have been nothing short of failure. America needs a leader. DJT is our chance to Save America.

**Americans are tired of being put second. It 's time to put AMERICA FIRST and Make America Great Once Again!**

On the last day of the RNC, I had the honor to speak to the New York delegation. I'm proud to be from New York. There is nothing more I would rather be doing than standing up for those from my home state. **_I 'm the last Republican standing in NYC. The Democrats would love to take control of my seat, but I refuse to let that happen._**

[](http://links.nicolemalliotakis.com/u/click?_t=759a85d1cba743719e64e2569e23c9b8&_m=304a442fb72a4b608257519881322c01&_e=0JTSGyek4yBYQm0ory7qXYX2agwn12u6dRkgT1_GXaUIBJPmNAMOYUlhLdamsq8QfzmuK_UI2wJjZyiYEzC5oiypHQ1-3ZO3Pb8wV7rx8FDRkV29JFbt0rhjPkV1ry3sIO1JYgcv6pjc0T7zDF_AcAIql6a7tm1w21OgPFZ7oNzVHfRan308dveKomUgOzvolLKqpt1utCEyI9rVsWPFxWTXb9_f57wzADjF6bNhvc8jyTUzNKWIMmA3KBTFsx236DEY_hBjGshr6H8EvZVkm9RfqEiL3SxIzYVkMmwHmXK9m7vIX8t92R0lzPoQj_xX)
**[Time after time, we've proven that the America First Movement is here to stay. Please join me in ensuring the America we know and love is here for future generations. Our nation is changing, but we can still make a difference if we act now. I'm proud to be serving NY-11 every single day, and I do not plan on stopping. Chip in today to help ensure the America First Movement lives on.](http://links.nicolemalliotakis.com/u/click?_t=759a85d1cba743719e64e2569e23c9b8&_m=304a442fb72a4b608257519881322c01&_e=0JTSGyek4yBYQm0ory7qXYX2agwn12u6dRkgT1_GXaUIBJPmNAMOYUlhLdamsq8QfzmuK_UI2wJjZyiYEzC5oiypHQ1-3ZO3Pb8wV7rx8FDRkV29JFbt0rhjPkV1ry3s9MqCH0MZcHCIOQQAOzFcGXkKev3p41uuXk2ZglmsMERVDI4almQ7oAhnxFEoRWEyURI6ftyn19TO9Knw-yfrv3F5xofP1z4zqHwTLBHKDTIQkYfUBvuiN-3WmvheaVYI4OTK4Ah7ppYm2cpNMNEOn-sOPGXiv2ffQ7fYVM8W6gBOg1ZF-p2GAnafILnOM7F-0DiJ0V8Djv-BSk38QkDPWA%3D%3D)**

_Nicole Malliotakis_

P.S. - Thank you to law enforcement from across the country who served in Wisconsin & went above & beyond to protect us. We will continue to support commonsense policies to fund our police & keep the streets of America safe!

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

In case you missed it, President Biden has officially withdrawn from the
November 2024 presidential race — opening the door for the next generation
to step up and lead as we work to defeat Donald Trump and MAGA extremism.

Since Day 1, Justice Democrats has been fighting to elect more young,
working-class, Black and brown progressives to office in order to end the
status quo and deliver the bold change our communities deserve.

This is a monumental election year, and we risk losing some of our most
progressive champions in Congress in next month’s primaries. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240722.R6Fw4o&refcode=em20240722-35802&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=35802%2E1203867%2EMF3-lq ]Will you
pitch in a grassroots contribution of $5 or more to help us
re-elect our incumbents, stop fascism in November, and continue investing
in the next generation?

— Justice Democrats

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Alexandra Rojas [us@list.justicedemocrats.com]
Date: Sun, Jul 21, 2024 at 5:38 PM
Subject: re: President Biden’s announcement
To: Peter [dpwillis67@gmail.com]

Breaking news, Peter:

President Biden just announced he is no longer running for a second term
and is dropping out of the November presidential race. We, of course,
welcome this decision and commend the President for doing what is best
both for the Democratic Party and our country as a whole.

That being said, President Biden and Party leadership should have never
let it get this far. We are on the brink of fascism once again, and the
stakes could not be higher. Democratic Party leadership and the
establishment have routinely shown us they would rather risk it all than
let the next generation lead.

Our mission at Justice Democrats has always been to recruit and elect the
next generation of diverse, working-class leaders to Congress who are
gonna fight like hell for all of us and do politics differently. That
mission has never been more important than in this moment.

The Squad in Congress — leaders like Jamaal Bowman, Cori Bush, Summer Lee,
Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Rashida Tlaib, and others — have been beacons of
hope and light in Congress.

Over the last 5 years, alongside other progressives in Congress, they have
shifted our expectations of how hard an elected leader can and should
fight for all of us. They have popularized and energized a base of
organized voters and volunteers who are ready to fight for worker’s
rights, Medicare for All, getting big money out of politics, a Green New
Deal, opposing genocide, and ending forever wars. And these are the people
that we need to put in the work and show up in November in order to defeat
Trump and deliver a Democratic victory.

We will continue to do our part alongside the Squad to organize our base
of voters and volunteers ahead of November to fight back against
right-wing extremism. Now, our country needs Party leadership to do the
same. It’s not just the White House at stake, but control of the House and
Senate too.

Regardless of what happens — we will continue to invest in the next
generation of voters and leaders who are ready to fight back. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240722.R6Fw4o&refcode=em20240722-35802&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=35802%2E1203867%2EMF3-lq ]If you’re
with us, send a grassroots donation of $5 to Justice
Democrats to help us stop fascism at the ballot box →

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240722.R6Fw4o&refcode=em20240722-35802&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1021&akid=35802%2E1203867%2EMF3-lq ]Contribute $5

This is a pivotal moment in history for our Party, our country, and our
democracy. With very little time on our side, let’s do everything in our
power to urgently come together and elect the leaders we deserve between
now and November 5th.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20240722-35802-footer&t=1022&refcode2=35802_1203867_MF3-lq&akid=35802%2E1203867%2EMF3-lq
